By controlling the parameters of the modeling, it dynamically simulates the development of cyber-society, and provides quantitative and scientific evidence for coordination and control between network society system and the subsystems, and thus makes the strategy-design and implementation more scientific.

articleTitle: An assessment of impact of environmental management system on corporate environmental and economic performance: An empirical study in chemical industry in Zhejiang province
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The governments, businesses and communities throughout the world have been faced with a variety of environmental challenges for several decades, ranging from air and water pollution to natural resource depletion and climate change. A severe debate about the relationship between environment and economy has been undergone over more than 10 years. During this period, an increasing number of businesses, government facilities, and other organizations have implemented formalized environmental management system (EMS) to manage the environmental aspects and impacts of their activities. By surveying 94 companies in chemical industry in Zhejiang province, this study aims to assess the impact of EMS on environmental and economic performance. After analyzing the data with SPSS regression model, it is found out that EMS does have a significant impact on both environmental performance and economic performance of surveyed corporations in Zhejiang province.

articleTitle: System analysis of business process model: A configuration perspective
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Business process model (BPM) is the kernel of applications, and also the basic elements of management system. The adaptability of BPM decided the applications adaptability of deployment and the capability of extending. Then how to understand the configuration of BPM well and truly, and how to analyze the configuration effectiveness are the pre-conditions that decided the design quality of BPM and to be compatible with the organization. So from a configuration perspective, put forward a system analysis method for BPM. Start from brought forward the configuration direction, namely horizontal, vertical and collaboration net. Then introduced the concept of configurable point (CP) and configuration parameter (CoP), and analysis the configuration effectiveness based on the CP and CoP. A case of customer-supplier total transaction process was identified base on the configuration direction and CP, CoP. Thus, combined with structural management that composed of three dimensions (sphere, process and control), the system analysis from configuration perspective constructed a analysis method of BPM for improvement and reengineering.

articleTitle: The strategy for guiding county-territory economy to the path of modern industrialization - a case study of Yunnan Province in China
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The development of county-territory economy in Yunnan Province has been consistence in a low level in the nation. This article first calculates the county-lever industrialization index in Yunnan through establishment of a mathematical model, thereby evaluates the lever of county industrialization in Yunnan in comparison to that of national average and proposes the importance and necessity of undergoing the modern industrialization path; It then further discusses the main questions that exist during the development of modern industrialization of county-territory economy in Yunnan Province; Finally, it points out the strategy and countermeasure for Yunnan province to develop its county-territory economy via a path of modern industrialization. The study of the paper has some theoretical and practical value for speeding up the development of the county-territory economy in Yunnan Province.

articleTitle: A retail-competition supply chain with promotion effort and sales learning curve
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Consider a single supplier-multiple retailers supply chain under retailers' promotional efforts and sales learning curve. The competition between retailers arises from substitution effect due to shortages. This paper incorporates the idea of sales learning curve into the promotion cost. Retailers determine the promotion and the replenishment policies while maximizing profits. The numerical analysis discusses the influences from retailer competition and sales learning curve on the behaviors of the channel. These results should be a useful reference for management and administrations.

articleTitle: The effect of downtime frequency at fixed machine availability in queuing systems
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: As efficient and accurate schemes, queuing models have usually been applied to approximate the behavior and characteristics of a system. However, most queuing models do not consider service interruptions. Although the previous studies have attempted to modify queuing models using availability, the frequency of server failure under fixed availability is still not considered. As previous study showed, the different frequency of server breakdown will result in various variations of service time as well as cycle time, even in a constant utilization level. This work presents a novel modified queuing model by applying availability and Mean Time to Repaired (MTTR). Consequently, the frequency of failure under fixed machine availability can be defined clearly in this model. In this work, Machine failure is regarded as an irregular customer to determine its impact on the system. The required service time and arrival rate of these irregular customers represent the behavior of machine breakdown. Therefore, the influence of machine failure on system performance is defined. The cycle time of each product with machine failure is also estimated accurately. Furthermore, the effect of various frequency of machine breakdown in a constant availability level is discovered in the result of simulation experiments. The experiments results also support that the proposed model could estimate the cycle time more accurately.

articleTitle: Complexity analysis of function modules for traffic portals in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Considering the large number of industries and data information provided by the traffic portal, the setting up of the functional modules has a certain complexity. Based on the survey of traffic portals' functional modules in Beijing and the comparison of the traffic portals, this paper discusses the complexity of functional modules of traffic portals and gives some proposals on how to design the functional modules. From the analysis of four different aspects, come to the conclusion that to regulate different functional modules' settings, as well as different portals' settings.It will help to improve the quality of its services.

articleTitle: Study on the choice of safety factor of stochastic lead time inventory model of distribution system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: An inventory model of secondary distribution system constituted by one distribution center and N retailers is established. Both the distribution center and the retailers adopt (Q,R) strategy, the lead-time of each retailers is subject to the stochastic fluctuation of the distribution center's shortage quantity. The security factor of the distribution center and each distributor is analyzed, the decision of the optimal security factor under the condition of non-cooperation is discussed and the conclusion of the model is proved by numerical examples.

articleTitle: The application of dynamic planning algorithm in automatic adjustment of train operation stage schedule for railway junction
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper constructs a mathematical model for automatic adjustment of train operation stage schedule for railway junction, considering the total delaying weighted time as target function and the factors which influence train operation, including train priority, time interval between trains spaced by automatic block signals, train operation time in sections, additional time when an train starts and parks, train accommodation capacity of station track, the earliest time when an train can depart from station and the fixed dwelling time as restriction conditions. Then the paper adopts dynamic planning algorithm and designs the corresponding procedures to work out the solution, finally provides dispatchers with valid adjustment option in real time. This method has been applied in Tianjin Railway junction TDCS and achieves good results.

articleTitle: A logistics costs control system based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper established an enterprise logistics costs control system including order processing, procurement, warehousing, producing and transportation these five subsystems. On this basis an evaluation index system was introduced at five aspects of cost, quality, time, information and services to measure costs of each logistics subsystem. Then a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model was established by using accelerated genetic algorithm (AGA) method to check and correct the consistency of judgment matrix and to calculate the weight of the indicators in evaluation index system to evaluate the logistics costs control system. Finally, the case shows that this method is easy, universal and objective and corresponding recommendations on applying logistics costs control system were also given.

articleTitle: Final-offer arbitration about post-sale compensation
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: In daily life, there are frequently some disputes about post-sale compensation in commodity consumption. These disputes are usually very time-consuming, and often caused a lower efficiency. Consumer and dealer are often at an impasse. This paper introduces a solution by appointing an arbitrator. The arbitrator determines the facts and then selects an offer from the sealed final offers that two parties submitted, and the selected final-offer becomes binding on both sides. Assume that the arbitrator after determining facts has some ideal value in mind, and suppose that in terms of one linear scale, the arbitrator selects the offer that is closer to his ideal. We discuss three special cases of this situation and analyze some of the strategic aspects of final-offer arbitration.

articleTitle: Study of trip time prediction based on urban trip information service platform
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper overviews home and abroad time estimation technology and methods for vehicle travel, then it puts forward trip time estimation model for buses based on urban bus travel information service platform. Considered walking time, waiting time and travel time, the linear regression model was built to predict travel time. As an example, Beijing Bus 300 is illustrated. The result shows that the model has superior prediction precision; therefore it would be valuable to integrate this forecast result to travel information service platform. Moreover, the algorithm and structure of this model is very simple, it could be transplanted to other rapid transit.

articleTitle: Research on the Customer Satisfaction Service System of certification body
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Operating in the environment of market economy and competition, the ideal operation mode for China Quality Certification Center (CQC), as an institution providing certification services, is the "Customer Satisfaction Service System (CSSS)", which takes customer satisfaction (CS) and creating greater values for stakeholders as its core concept; the basic operating process is a "sensed - responding" type trilogy with "listening and measuring - interpreting and learning - improving and innovating"; the basic organization form is a kind of structure based upon team and organizational learning; and the internal operating mechanism is CS-oriented activation, learning, improvement and innovation, as well as the cultural coordination and integration. Fundamental tools and measures boosting the CSSS are the customer satisfaction measurement, analysis and improvement. CSSS has provided a systematic idea mode for the organization transformation and management innovation of certification bodies in the new era.

articleTitle: A simulation model for intra-terminal transport of Container Terminal operations system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The research is based on investigating and studying various real container terminals operations systems. Firstly, intra-terminal transport is defined in the container terminal operations system that is a discrete event dynamic system and its entities, events, activities and process are analyzed. Secondly, based on identifying the various congestions, the simulation model is proposed. The cycle-time consists of the four stochastic variables: the non-stop traveling time of the cycle, the waiting time at berth, the waiting time at yard, and the abnormal waiting time in a cycle due to congestion or operations management. Finally, container terminals of phase I of Shanghai Yangshan Port and Shanghai Waigaoqiao Container Terminal are chosen as a case to study how to determine the quay-yard cycle time and the operation-line productivities in the quay-yard cycle for a planning terminal that has not been established. This research indicates that this simulation model for intra-terminal transport can be applicable to any of the five typical container-terminal handling systems and the empirical equation obtained in case study can make sense for the simulation model for inter-terminal transport.

articleTitle: The factor analysis of asset appraisal deviation
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Now, asset appraisal is playing more and more vital role in market economy movement. It is necessary for an enterprise to come into the market. When a listed company is purchased or annexed, asset appraisal is the basis of trade negotiation. In order to improve the asset appraisal quality well, researching on asset appraisal deviation is essential. In this paper, 261 samples asset appraisal report abstracts during 2004-2006 were chosen as data source. The factor analysis methods were used to inspect the relation between six influence variables and asset appraisal deviation. The scores of six factors were calculated. By factor analysis, the six factors could be divided into three public factors. To investigate the influence of three factors on asset appraisal deviation, the polynomial regression model PZL = B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> + B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> + B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> + B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> was adopted. Significant test discovered that the asset appraisal deviation with these three public factors was appropriate.

articleTitle: Loan to value to newsvendor based on buyer's credit under inhouse consignment structure
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: At present, the bank is facing a challenging design problem of credit contract based on inventory financing. The paper studies credit contracts based on buyer's credit with two risk-neutral gamers under the outsource structure of inhouse consignment. The model includes the case of a bank offering loan to a cooperative retailer who mortgages its inventory to the bank to finance more inventory. The retailer faces a random demand in a single sales season as in the classical newsvendor problem. By game theorem, the paper gives the optimal loan to value to retailers with different initial capital. We show the wholesale price, the storage cost and the salvage price have influence to bankruptcy risk and loan to value, as well as the initial capital. Finally, based on our model analysis, we give some advices.

articleTitle: A two-warehouse inventory model for items under conditions of permissible delay in payments
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: In this paper, a two-warehouse inventory problem under conditions of permissible delay in payments is considered. As a matter of fact, the inventory system discussed by this paper is a special case of Huang's(2006) model. Although his study simplifies the solution procedure, the existence of some optimal solutions must satisfy non-negative condition. That is, the discussion on the optimal solutions is not comprehensive. This article deals with an alternative approach to present a simple procedure in order to determine the optimal replenishment cycle when the supplier provides the retailer a permissible delay in payments. Some theorems are proposed to find the optimal cycle time and numerical examples are given to illustrate the proposed theorems.

articleTitle: Conceptual framework of information modeling for construction projects
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Although information technology (IT) is being applied to various aspects of construction projects during their lifecycle, there is a need for an integrated IT system so that authorized users can record, view, query and update information when needed. Through analyzing key issues of project management over project lifecycle, this paper proposed a conceptual framework of information modeling for construction projects (PIM) . The framework consists of three key components in a network-based environment: (1) a master data management system; (2) a project information portal (PIP); and (3) a various number of applications. A successful PIM system would provide a representation of the project process to facilitate exchange and interoperability of information in digital format.

articleTitle: Incorporating routing and inventory cost in strategic distribution network design model for a chain enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: In this paper, we consider a strategic distribution network design problem for a chain enterprise, in which the decision maker needs to decide the number and location of the distribution centers (DCs) and system inventory control decisions-such as economic order quantity and safety stock decisions. In the chain enterprise, stores face random customer demand, and each store and DC, respectively, maintains a certain amount of safety stock in order to achieve a certain service level for the customers or the stores it serves. The objective is to minimize the total cost that includes location costs, inventory costs, and distribution costs in the chain enterprise. We show that this problem can be formulated as a nonlinear integer programming model, for which we propose a Lagrangian relaxation based solution algorithm. In a numerical application, we found that the benefits of having an integrated distribution design framework that includes location, inventory, and routing decisions in the same optimization model.

articleTitle: A basic model of knowledge capacity field for enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The existence and the interacting methods of knowledge capacity in organization has its obvious attribute - "field-state". The knowledge capacity field is composed of employees, organization, business, enterprise resources, performance, knowledge capacity and their interaction. The business mode embodies the knowledge capacity field concretely, which has the configuration and the characteristics of field.

articleTitle: A self-adapted feedback algorithm for video transmission over the Internet
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Real-time video communication is very important to the Internet applications of video conferencing, video telephony, video-on-demand, and etc. However, the heavy traffic of video data along with its timing constraints makes it a challenge to provide large-scale, high QoS media streaming service over the current best-effect network. This paper presents a self-adapted feedback algorithm for video transmission which is based on the FEC coding technology and the KALMAN filter theory. By modifying the rate using the adapted KALMAN filter, this algorithm efficiently solves the problem of rate fluctuation caused by the lost packets. It reduces the network load caused by the retransmission of lost packets. It also weakens the influence of the loss of elementary layer packets (or other important contents) in transmission and provides the continuity of the video transmission over Internet. Simulation results indicate that this algorithm can guarantee satisfied performance for video transmission in the high-packet- lost networks.

articleTitle: Logistics capability construction based on customer satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The concept of logistics capability is analyzed from the perspective of customer satisfaction and a study of the relationship between the customer satisfaction and logistics capability is made in this paper. Based on the analysis, a model is built, in which the method of marginal utility is used and a conclusion that when logistics capability meets a certain condition the customer satisfaction is maximized is found out. Furthermore, a program about constructing logistics capability to maximize the customer satisfaction is made. At the end, an example shows how to construct logistics capability that maximizes the customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: New optimization method for urban transit network-CVO method
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Transit network planning project is implemented by a series of short-term transit network optimization processes. Considering transit flows data is easily got by transit companies, this paper introduces a simple new method on short-term optimization for transit network-CVO method, which is convenient for transit companies. The CVO method is realized with the transportation software-TransCAD based on transit IC card database under the guidance of long-term transit network planning project. In the method, minimizing the gross of passengers' turnover is the optimization objective and minimizing the gross of travel distance of all the transit buses is the accessorial optimization objective. The model has been proved to be effective and convenient when used in transit network optimization in Changchun.

articleTitle: The empirical analysis of sensation in customer lifetime value
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: One of the core competitive ability of company is regarding the customer management as the center issue. The view that long-term and stable customer is an important invisible asset of company has been commonly accepted by most scholars. This article analyzes the customer value sensation, the factors that influence the customer value and the ones that related to the building up of customer accounting system of our airline companies. The results of the survey indicate that the customer management of the airline companies is still on a poor level. However, the sensation level of the employees of the airline company exceeds the average level of measurement. All the employees want to manage the long-term and stable customers as an asset of company, accounting them and publish the information in the future.

articleTitle: Electric power enterprise financial risk evaluation based on Rough Set and BP network
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The comprehensive evaluation problem of electric power listed corporation has always been a focus since market-oriented reform of the electric power industry, and financial risk evaluation play a key role to science investment decision of electric power listed corporation .This paper presents a new composite forecasting method for financial risk of electric power corporation, modeling and forecasting based on rough set and back-propagation neural network model. Combing reality financial data of electric power listed corporation and using rough set theory to select financial indexes, which are as modeling variables, then establishing financial risk estimation model based on Back-propagation neural network. Through training for the financial data, it shows that this model has a high accuracy to the results of financial risks evaluation, and it offers effective technical support to financial risk evading of electric power enterprise.

articleTitle: The strategies of online third-party payment based on market competition
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: There is an increasingly competitive market of online third-party payment in China. This paper describes the online third-party payment patterns of competition among enterprises based on Porter's "five-force model". Then some appropriate competitive strategies are proposed combined with two cases study, cncard.net and shfft.com.

articleTitle: The extent and depth of e-commerce employees' professional knowledge in service industry
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The study aims to explore the extent and depth of electronic commerce employees' professional knowledge in the service industry. To achieve this goal, the study uses interviews and panel discussions to confirm employees' professional knowledge. In addition, the study utilizes transformation of knowledge and ability to select representative knowledge items and to confirm the professional knowledge structure of low-level employees, midlevel leaders, and managers through mental mapping. Employees in electronic commerce times should have these five categories, totaling 95 items, such as essential professional knowledge item; that is, commerce flow, cash flow, information flow, service flow and transportation flow, in order to cultivate employees' abilities of e-commerce effectively. Core professional knowledge of electronic commerce employees should total 2 items including customer service technique and customer satisfaction plan.

articleTitle: Research on the formation of logistics information and establishment of fuzzy evaluation model
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Based on supply chain, the paper analyzes the formation of logistics information, and concludes the layer and covering modules of it. Then, according to the construction of logistics enterprise information we establish the objective and efficient four-dimension logistics enterprise information evaluation index system. What's more, using triangular fuzzy number, we apply the evaluation model to appointed enterprise.

articleTitle: Analysis of coordination mechanisms in a two-echelon supply chain
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Coordinating the supply chain is a main object of supply chain management, and an inventory decision model is developed to analyze the coordination of a two-echelon supply chain with one supplier and one retailer. The products in our paper are perishable and sold over a single selling season. After discussing a pure wholesale price contract, we put forward a return contract. Then several tactics are proposed to improve the performance of the traditional return contract. All our findings are illustrated by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Research on traffic volume forecast and assignment of Logistics Park
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: As an important phase in the plan of Logistics Park, traffic volume forecast and traffic assignment are always the research focus.In this paper, the improved Traffic Volume Non-repeated Coefficient Method was introduced to forecast the Traffic Volume of Logistics Park, based on the results, System Optimization Assignment Model was used for Traffic Assignment of Logistics Park with the aid of TRANSCAD. The experimental result may be provided for the road network planning of Logistics Park, making the traffic organization of Logistics Park more effective and optimal. Then, it will bring tremendous economic benefits and social benefits.

articleTitle: Study on the distribution modes selection of the regional food cold chain
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper analyses the distribution modes selection of the regional food cold chain with the method of fuzzy evaluation, and uses AHP to ensure the weight of the index. At first, the paper analyses the mode of food cold chain and influence factors. Then it illustrates the problem of mode selection of the regional food cold chain, states the principle of index system of evaluation and steps to use and establish the index system of evaluation. In the end, this paper sets an example.

articleTitle: The capacitated production planning problem with sequence-dependent changeovers
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper addresses the multi-machine multi-item capacitated production planning problem with sequence-dependent changeovers that faced by most process industries. A new mixed-integer programming model formulation and its incorporation into a fix-and-relax heuristic are proposed. Numerical studies from test instances of different size exhibit that the developed heuristic approach is capable of solving large instances within a reasonable amount of time and indicate superior solution qualities.

articleTitle: Workforce management in project-oriented shared service organization
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The typical project-oriented service organizations conduct dozens of projects and programs every year. A common occurrence in these organizations is many requests from business units with no apparent link to strategy goals. So they often face workforce management and project prioritization issues with a constrained budget and limited human resources. Research and experience indicate that the governance of workforce and project prioritization is critical to organization success. This article reviews actions that a shared service organization taken to meet resource-competing requests from multiple business units. Specifically, the authors discuss some key advanced technologies such as a complete model for selecting projects, skill representation and resource allocation problem, together with experiences gained from a bank in Asia Pacific.

articleTitle: Research on location of cold logistic chains distribution centers based on grey correlation degree and AHP method
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper indicates the implications and characteristics of the cold logistic chains, and the key evaluation index system in the course of location problem of logistics distribution centers is established and proposes an approach that the grey correlation degree and analytic hierarchical process (AHP) can solve the location problem of cold logistic chains distribution centers. A numerical example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Build competitive advantage through the integration of sustainable supply chains
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Sustainability and corporate citizenship is a social ideal and a business necessity. Being sustainable is now a source of competitive advantage and a matter of corporate survival rather than a costly burden. Now many companies look on sustainability as a top-line priority. However, satisfying profit and sound corporate sustainability behavior will go unfulfilled unless orderly supply chains literally and sustainably "deliver the goods". Achieving genuine sustainability is the result of making supply chains more sustainable. Since typically 50 percent of a product's value, and often upward of 70 percent, is derived from suppliers, claims of corporate sustainability are likely just empty promises without the support from the whole supply chain. Companies and consumers realize that customers do not just buy products, they also buy the whole supply chain that delivers the products. We organize our key views in four parts. At first, after a brief introduction, we discuss the reason of building sustainable supply chains, and the relation between a sustainable firm and sustainable supply chains. Then, we described the characteristics of sustainable supply chain management, including devising a sustainable strategy, retooling the organization, managing supplier relations and monitoring and enforcing performance. Thirdly, we provide some advice on how to build the sustainable supply chains, and on the base of which to help a firm to build up its sustainable competitive advantage, in the end of the paper, we take Timberland as a case for further discussion.

articleTitle: Train-set turnover optimization model and algorithm based on SA considering workload balance among maintenance bases
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Maintenance arrangement is a key factor in the quality of the train-set turnover plan making. It requires considering workload balance among all the maintenance bases. Therefore in this paper maintenance workload is transformed into a special kind of train, whose beginning and ending stations are the same, and constitute a train-set turnover network by regarding the train as dot, the linkage as border, and the linkage time as the weight of border. The train-set turnover linkage problem now becomes a unique TSP problem on the network. An optimization algorithm is developed based on SA and the effectiveness of the model and the algorithm is verified through an applied case study on the Beijing-Tianjin Line.

articleTitle: A video broadcast architecture utilizing the locality properties
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: We proposes a hybrid architecture MTreeTV which combines the use of P2P networks with dedicated streaming servers, and was proposed to build on the advantages of both P2P and CDN paradigms. MTreeTV uses a novel locality-aware overlay construction and scheduling algorithm to assure the effectiveness of P2P overlay. We also study the placement of the servers with constraints on the client to server paths and evaluate the effect of the server parameters. Through analysis and simulation, we show that MTreeTV supports fast channel switching (<4s).

articleTitle: Supply chain event management in multimodal transportation
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Multimodal transportation is one of the important fields in the supply chain management. Multiple parties participate in one shipment transportation. As shipment transportation in supply chains become more dynamic, there is a need for a sense-and-respond capability to react to events in a real-time manner. It is important to create an efficient and visible transportation plan to monitor and manage the supply chain events. In this paper, we use the color Petri Net to create the transportation plan in our first-phase study.

articleTitle: Risk prediction of project scheduling based cloud model
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: In project scheduling management, cloud operation and cloud model are introduced for a better consideration of both randomicity and fuzziness in project scheduling, as well as their relationship, giving us a clearer view of uncertainty in the project. Traditional methods, like probability statistics analysis and fuzzy mathematics, focus on their respective fields, that is, the former attaches more importance on randomicity while the latter considers fuzziness only. Based on the normal cloud model of project optimal scheduling, we have calculated the certainty index of completion probability and completion risk, and also made a relative analysis of randomicity and fuzziness, so that more information is provided for project management and decision.

articleTitle: The construction of ecological logistics park based on network shape enterprises symbiotic relationship model
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Based on the idea of environmental protection, with network shape enterprise symbiotic relationship model, and make an analysis about how to establish a stable symbiotic model among enterprises in the internal logistics park. Through the analysis, regard that the construction of the ecological Logistics Park in that is based on the model of network shape enterprises symbiotic relationship is the mainstream model of development in the future.

articleTitle: Robust design method in quality engineering and its application
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Robust parameter design is a quality engineering method that aims at reducing sensitivity to hard-to-control variation in products and manufacturing. This paper's research mainly pays attention to estimate the performance measure of dynamic characteristic parameter design. Based on the related researches, the paper proposes the correlation coefficient and S/N to estimate the linearity of response with signal factor and the dispersion effects of response. The results are illustrated with example of measuring micro amount of As using spectrophotometer. Based on the robust parameters design the optimum experimental conditions and the ideal work curve are obtained. It can be applied to determination of micro amount of As about pretreatment the bacteria in the difficult to soak gold ore by spectrophotometer.

articleTitle: Study on the Customer Order Decoupling Point position base on profit
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: CODP (customer order decoupling point) is the boundary between make-to-stock (MTS) and make-to-order (MTO), and can determine the effectiveness of MC (Mass customization). This text build up a model for the CODP position base on profit, in this model, we establish the relationship between the position of CODP and the sales, then use M/M/N system of tandem queues to predigest the model. After that, give the solving method. In the end, from the numerical analysis, we validate the model, and give three deductions. From this, we can make the companies understand the CODP better, and make the reasonable position of CODP, so the low cost, customization, quick response can be implement at the same time.

articleTitle: Research on forecast method for collector-distributor transport demand of ports based on category feature of cargoes
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Collector-distributor transport demand forecast is an essential problem during development of collector-distributor systems of ports. In view of that traditional methods forecasting collector-distributor transport demand of ports only by weight are not realistic, this paper discusses the main factors which affect collector-distributor transport demand forecast of ports, then proposes a new method based on analysis of category feature of cargoes, finally reveals that the new method is reasonable and superior in collector-distributor transport demand forecast of ports through comparison with traditional method.

articleTitle: The impact of stock disruptions on performance of e-collaboration supply chain
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The impact of stock disruptions on supply chain performance is analyzed by using system dynamics simulation. Performances of three different supply chains with Internet e-collaboration tools are compared with the assumption that a stock disruption occurs within two echelons in a four-echelon supply chain respectively. Numerical results are shown to reveal the Non-collaborative, Collaborative Forecasting and Collaborative Planning supply chains have completely different response characteristics under certain stock disaster, and Collaborative Forecasting supply chain has outstanding behavior in case of these stock events. Finally some conclusions to resist supply chain stock disruptions are concluded.

articleTitle: Pricing competition and coordination of a supply chain with duopolistic retailers
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper considers the pricing and order coordination decisions in a two-echelon supply chain with one manufacturer who supplies a single product to duopolistic retailers, whose demands interact with the assumption of being price-sensitive. The problem is analyzed under the Stackelberg structure, in which the manufacturer acting as a leader declares her wholesale price and a common-replenishment epochs (CRE) schedule to competitive retailers, and the duopolistic retailers acting as followers respond with their sales prices and associated order policies. The effects of CRE policy on the optimal decisions are analyzed. And the numerical example is presented to confirm all the results.

articleTitle: The impact of introduction of Forward Freight Agreement on spot market
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Purpose of this paper is to investigate the impact of introduction of tanker FFA (Forward Freight Agreements) on spot rates, choosing three routes (TD3, TD5 and TD7). This paper applies the Stochastic Volatility (SV) models which consider the factors both Forward Freight Agreements and other economic indices. The parameters of SV models are estimated via the software package BUGS (Bayesian inference using Gibbs Sampling). According to analyze the economic insignificant of parameter in the models, and get the conclusion that there is some impact, introduction of tanker Forward Freight Agreements increasing the volatility of spot rates.

articleTitle: Research on inventory game of supply chain based on credit coordination mechanism
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Nowadays, supply chain coordination has become the major concern problem in optimization cost, and inventory control is the main way to improve the performance or reduce cost. Based on cooperation and symmetry information, this paper builds up inventory control model for supplier and retailer system in which retailer is the core enterprise. Then, the supply chain realizes the optimal total cost through offering trade credit and obtains the Nash equilibrium policy and optimal ordering policy through discussing the game model. Finally, the efficiency of the policy is illustrated by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Research on ontology evolution model based on immune theory
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Immune theory is introduced into ontology evolution process to realize ontology evolution. First of all, the paper sets up a formal evolution-oriented ontology model and the evolution framework, and then establishes an ontology evolution model through analyzing the deficiencies of existing ontology evolution research. Finally, it analyzes the process and steps of self-evolution when the domain, user needs or the environment changes. It also lays the foundation for the further research.

articleTitle: Research on value-adding equilibrium of complex supply chain networks
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: With the intensive competitions in global market, enterprises need to apply cooperative and competitive postures to manage their relationships with their supply chain members as well as the firms in the other supply chains. While todayiquests supply chains are evolving into more complicated network structures, most of the researches today are focused on the competition game among the upstream and downstream companies around the core company in the single supply chain networks (SSCN), and the cooperation-competition relationships among the SSCNs are somehow ignored. This paper first describes the structure of the complex supply chain networks (CSCN) that are formed by different SSCNs. Then, using the game theory, the paper studies the value-adding equilibrium between the SSCNs in the CSCN, and establishes the value-adding equilibrium model of the CSCNs under imperfect cost information.

articleTitle: The integration of constraint programming and mathematical programming
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Aiming at the integration of constraint programming (CP) and mathematical programming (MP), which are used to solve combinatorial optimization problems, the paper analyzes the characteristic and integration schemes of both optimization techniques. Based on previous work, an integration framework is introduced and implemented on parallel machine scheduling problem in ILOG OPL. Simulation experiments show that the integration of CP and MP is efficient.

articleTitle: A robust image transmission strategy over wireless channels
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: A robust image transmission strategy over wireless channels was proposed by interpolating a coding controller between source coder and channel coder. According to the characteristics of channel and compressed bit stream, the coding controller dynamically allocates the coding rate for source coder and channel coder. Moreover, an adjustable retransmission controller combined with CRC module is also used at receiving terminals to determine whether the current data packet should be retransmitted or not according to its importance. Simulation results show that the proposed strategy is efficient in achieving acceptable image quality, especially in low signal noise ratio and high compress rate for image wireless transmission system.

articleTitle: Off-line handwritten digit recognition based on improved BP artificial neural network
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper improved the adaptive factor of gradient to improve the transfer function on the base of the means of momentum, aimed at the training difficult to escape the flat area of error. This method had an application on off-line handwritten recognition. The results showed: this method could not only raise precision of BP artificial neural network, but also improve the convergent speed of it.

articleTitle: The research of calculation model of QoS for service composition based on 0-1 programming
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Web Service is the best realization of SOA, which plays an important role in service computation. With the continuous development of service composition and increasing diversification of business demands, there are more than one solution can be proposed to provide the similar service. Under such circumstances, how to measure the quality of solution quantitatively becomes the research focus of service composition field. In this paper, we analyze the key factors of composite service from domain and runtime angle and classify the elements into three types by using HTN planning, besides this, an calculation model for value of composite service quality is constructed based on the 0-1 programming and implement an instance of service composition with this methodology.

articleTitle: Supply chain collaborative advantage: A firm's perspective
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The objective of the study is to uncover the nature and characteristics of collaborative advantage from a focal firm's perspective. Collaborative advantage is defined as strategic benefits gained over competitors in the marketplace through supply chain partnering, and it relates to the desired synergistic outcome of collaborative activity that could not have been achieved by any firm acting alone. The research conceptualizes collaborative advantage as the five dimensions: process efficiency, offering flexibility, business synergy, quality, and innovation. Reliable and valid instruments were developed through rigorous empirical analysis including structured interviews, Q-sort, and a large-scale study. Data were collected through a Web survey of U.S. manufacturing firms in various industries. The statistical methods used include structural equation modeling (i.e., LISREL). The construct definition and measures in this study have provided a rich and structured understanding of collaborative advantage in a supply network.

articleTitle: Research on sea-cargo contract coordination under reference effect of forwarder's downstream customers
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Forwarder's downstream customers basically procure shipping space from forwarders, and always make expectations about spot price, and then make ordering decisions based on comparison between expectation and contract price. This paper introduces the price reference effect of forwarder's customers into cargo contract coordination, and analyzes the capacity allocation and pricing coordination between carrier and forwarder when the customers have price reference effect. And then we analyze the situation where the reference effect is asymmetrical. Because of the asymmetrical reference effect, forwarder exploits opportunism to get dual profits from lower contract price and higher ordering quantity; and under specific conditions, the reference effect also can make carrier get more welfare. Finally, we analyze ordering price and profit difference between symmetrical reference and asymmetrical reference.

articleTitle: Coordination of supply chains with stochastic demand through option contract
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper develops a model to study channel coordination and risk sharing in a supply chain with stochastic demand. We investigate a coordinating contract based on an option with two parameters. The option price and the exercise price are determined by the supplier. Based on the decision models which are set up for different members, the supplier's optimal pricing and capacity policy are discussed, as well as the retailer's ordering strategy. According to the analysis of option mechanism, we prove that such a contract brings benefit to each party.

articleTitle: The strategic direction taken by innovative managing mode in China's EMI
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: With the spur of information technology, fundamental transitions have happened in the international manufacturing industry : from real manufacturing to virtual manufacturing, from independent manufacturing to networking final assembling manufacturing, from local manufacturing to transplanting manufacturing, from closed technological research to global cooperative research, etc. Although the overall operating state is fine with Chinese equipment manufacturing industry (EMI), there also exist some problems: unbalanced development among different enterprises, some of which are seriously losing, the concentration ratio of enterprises is low and lack of clustering efficiency, the weak ability of independent technical innovation. The utmost solution should come from the following aspects: standardize products management, realize the complete information-based management, realize independency of technological innovation and enterprises as the subject of innovation, build dynamic regional innovative network and realize industry clustering.

articleTitle: Simulation of resource integration system of vocational education based on Arena
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The level of development of vocational education and vocational education quality is good or bad, depending on the merits of vocational education resources and efficiency. Today, to enhance the competitiveness of vocational education in China, it is important and urgent to integrate the vocational education resources particularly. The paper describes briefly the resource integration system of vocational education, establishes the model of the system with Arena on the basis on discrete events system. By the simulation, its optimal scheme is got.

articleTitle: On loan-to-value ratio of inventory financing under static pledge and dynamic pledge fashion
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Given the price of pledged inventory follows geometric Brownian motions, the paper implements risk estimation strategies of "main body+ debt" and comparatively analyzes loan-to-value ratio decision of banks under static pledge and dynamic pledge fashion. Based on these theory results, the case about inventory financing developed by banks and cooperating logistic firms is analyzed. The study shows: if price distribution of the inventory at the end of the loan may be acquired, analytic result of loan-to-value ratio in static pledge fashion can be solved; if the price of pledged inventory follows geometric Brownian motions, the largest loan-to-value under dynamic pledge fashion is determined.

articleTitle: Study on operational mode of logistics enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: With the fast growth in China's economy, the demand for logistics services has been growing significantly in China. China's logistics service providers need to pay more attention to seek more potential business. The purpose of this paper is to study the operational mode of logistics services providers through the comparison between logistics demand and logistics supply. Based on on-spot investigation in Beijing and Tianjin, this paper analyzes the actual logistics demand from the companies and the satisfaction degree to logistics enterprises, then the available logistics service items came out. The discrepancy between the logistics supply and demand is derived, which provides suggestions for the logistics enterprises to select the reasonable operational modes and suitable logistics service items. Boston Matrix is used to analyze the research result.

articleTitle: Planning of a case-based reasoning logistics service project system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Traditionally, when they provide various services for customers, the logistics service providers always spend more time on designing service projects by seasoned person without any decision support tolls. The service projects made by this way unavoidably have some deviation. For improving service efficiency and the level of customer satisfaction, this paper tries to construct a effective logistics service project system based on CBR to help logistic service providers designing individuation service projects for different customers.

articleTitle: Analysis on supply capability in seaborne-coal supply logistics system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Most of the big power plants locate at the coastal areas in order to get fuel by sea-borne transport (SBT). Power plant can be benefited from the SBT of shipping large quantities of cargo in one hand, but has to suffer the inaccurate delivery schedule on the other. Inaccurate delivery time of SBT is likely caused by heavy weather en route or the misarranging of loading or discharging operations and will definitely affect the normal production of the power plant. Early bird ships may bring huge amount of demurrage and late delivery of fuel will definitely arise extremely high shortage cost. Yet, the variation and uncertainty of delivery cannot be eliminated thoroughly in the SBT, and the sole requirement is to improve the supplying capability of the sea-borne supply chain. This paper tries to simulate the SBT by means of WITNESS software, analyze and evaluate the capability of sea-borne fuel supply chain of a power plant. The results can be used both in improving the capability of SBT and the optimization of resources allocation of the sea-borne fuel supply chain.

articleTitle: Application of Grey Jump Model to forecast fluctuating inventory demand
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper proposes a model that is grey jump model based on the central-approximant grey model and liner regression model. Because some products are characteristic of short life-cycle and large demand-fluctuation, it carries the forecast on jumping points with Central-approximant Grey Model and other non-jumping points with liner regression model. Finally, it puts these two parts together to forecast and testifies that the model has high precision as well as coordinates the practice well. So this paper provides an effective method for forecasting on the inventory demand which fluctuate sharply.

articleTitle: Knowledge transfer model of integrated system ..... take ERP implementation for example
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This article is based on the theory of knowledge transfer and takes the implementation of ERP for example. It analyses the knowledge transfer system and establishes a comprehensive system of knowledge transfer model. The purpose is to improve the effectiveness of ERP implementation. Firstly, starts with the basic principles, the whole text explains the concept of knowledge transfer, the activities of organization in knowledge transfer systems, the knowledge transfer process, the types of knowledge transfer, knowledge transfer system and so on; Secondly, it introduces the problems of knowledge transfer among the three parties, including the corporate, the software implementation party and the consulting company; Finally, it establishes an integrated system of the ERP knowledge transfer model and illustrates the degree of importance about knowledge transfer system in ERP implementation by using the upper theories and methods.

articleTitle: Analysis of supply chain adaptability based on self-organization
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper discusses current level and inadequacies of researches on adaptability of supply chain, from the viewpoint of the relationship between supply chain and external environment, explains the concept and connotation of adaptability of supply chain, makes use of self-organization to analyze the adaptive process and mechanism, and puts forward methods to enhance the adaptability of supply chain.

articleTitle: Model and scheduling of a continuous galvanizing line
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a continuous galvanizing line in a steel plant which is one of the biggest iron and steel enterprises of the world. The continuous galvanizing line we research produces principally two kinds of coils, inner coils and outer coils. Due to the technical constraint, outer coils can not be produced continuously more than a specified number. So the inner coils must be inserted between outer coils. The difficulty of solving the problem is the interrelation of sequencing these two kinds of coils. No model and algorithm about such a scheduling problem has been published. We propose an integer programming model to describe the scheduling problem. To solve the problem, a heuristic based on tabu search is developed. Due to the model of the scheduling problem is an integer programming model, problems with less than 100 coils can be solved by CPLEX 11.0 MIP optimizer to obtain the optimal solution or a lower bound of the problem. By comparing our heuristic schedule and the CPLEX schedule, the tabu search heuristic is proven to be effective.

articleTitle: Simulation study of multi-agent-based network manufacturing ASP system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The increasing competition in market and particular demand of customer bring the unprecedented challenges to small and medium-sized enterprises. In order to adapt to the new circumstances, the enterprises should take full advantage of the vast network resources to enhance their productivity. A multi-agent-based network manufacturing ASP (Application Service Provider) platform has so many advantages on resources, efficiency and cost, so it is an important way to promote the informationization of small and medium-sized enterprises. A detailed working flowchart model based on MAS (Multi-Agent System) theory is established in the paper. The resource management subsystem of the network manufacturing ASP system is based on multi-agent. Agents have been divided and formally described and the internal structure, the behavior method, the active flow, the communication language as well as the management pattern of the agent has been studied. Each agent can communicate and collaborate with the others, so that the system exhibits certain intelligence in resource choice and decision-making. The purpose of the research is to offer a feasible pathway for information industry constructing of Chinese manufacturing enterprises.

articleTitle: Capacity mechanism analysis based on dynamic simulation of generation investment
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Generation capacity investment holds the origin of the electric power supply chain, and creates significant impacts on the reliability of power supply service. Based on the system dynamics theory, this paper builds up a model that describes the development of electric power generation investment, and uses the model to perform the dynamic simulation of generation capacity investment in different market scenarios, such as the energy-only market and the capacity payment mechanism. Particularly, imperfections of the real world are taken into consideration, which is reflected by the accuracy of load forecast. The simulation shows that generation investment would fluctuate due to the volatility of price and imperfection of information, even if the average revenue recovers the investment cost of the optimal installation, and thus result in shortage of supply in the market. Furthermore, suitable capacity mechanisms help reduce the possibility of shortage, but may trigger overinvestment in generation capacity and remain the fluctuation that threatens the reliability of power supply service.

articleTitle: An optimal policy for nonstationary inventory problems with service level constraint
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper considers a general inventory control problem with nonstationary stochastic demand and service level constraint. By analyze the inventory relationship between the decision making periods, a new inventory model is established, which regressively estimate the inventory cost from the last replenishment period to the first. Then a solution algorithm is provided, and the optimal solution has the nonstationary (s, S) form. Comparison with existing method illustrates the optimality of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on transnational marketing risk and evaluation index system of Chinese retail enterprises
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Retail enterprises have to face complex international risks during transnational marketing. Based on the situation of Chinese retail enterprises, using Miler's international risk model for reference, the paper analyzes three kinds of risks for retail enterprises transnational marketing. On the basis of these, a risk evaluation index system which aims at transnational marketing environment of retail enterprises is set and fuzzy comprehensive appraisal also introduced. At last, the system is used to analyze the case of Tiankelong Group.

articleTitle: Gender and customer loyalty
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This study aims to discuss the influence that gender has on customer loyalty in the retail settings. Significant gender differences which reveal that females are more loyal than males in the service sector are supported by research done earlier [10]. Previous research in the product retailing context focusing on the case of light-fitting has found that males are more loyal than females which is contrary to the literature [7]. This study investigates a more general product category- clothing to minimize the impact that product characteristics could have on the result. Interestingly, the same result has been achieved which suggests that males are more loyal than females in product retail settings.

articleTitle: Outsourcing in small and medium-size enterprises of China
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: With the increasing of the competition in the global market, the outsourcing strategies for enterprises are necessary to be studied and changed in order to shake down the dramatic environment. As a result, focusing on the core business has been becoming an important strategy for its advantages of reducing and controlling operating cost, improving company focus and so on. It gets clearer through such a survey of moderate organizations in different economic zones of China reported in this paper, after streamlined by the methodology of statistics package for the social science (SPSS). The study concerns the motivation, partnership with outsourcers, advantages and problems, satisfactions in contrast with a theoretical framework of practice and problems derived from the literature. All these methodologies are very useful for forming and practicing their outsourcing.

articleTitle: A new calculation algorithm for quantile function with application to headway distribution
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The maximum entropy approach is a flexible and powerful tool for probability curve approximation. This paper presents an effective algorithm for estimating parameters of the maximum entropy quantile function subject to probability-weighted moments constraints. The algorithm is proposed by utilizing optimization method to estimate parameters that would lead to the best-fit quantile function. The central idea of the algorithm is to transfer the problem of finding roots of equations to the problem of equivalent optimization. The numerical examples presented in the paper illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis on the airport terminal bonded logistic park planning and industry economic effect
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: With the enhancing of Chinese economics, the business between cities, regions and countries expends rapidly. It causes that logistic flux is increasing, and many cities regard the establishment of logistic park as the important part of the developing stratagem of modern logistic industry. The airport terminal bonded logistic park is the typical zone for promoting international port industry and modern logistic industry which enjoys the special policy of bonded zone and adopts particular scrutiny and management mode. This paper analyzes the integrated relationship between the airport terminal bonded logistic park and the hub airport. And points out the airport terminal bonded logistic park's basic structure and main function platform, according to the airport terminal bonded logistic park's formation mechanisms and operating mode. Besides, as one of the focus point, this paper analyzes the airport terminal bonded logistic park's industrial economic influence on capital economic effect, industrial-driving, industrial structure's optimized effect, regional benefits, income effect and aggregation effect.

articleTitle: The information & communications technological system of China
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The aim of this paper is to study the information and communications technological system (ICTS) of China from a sectoral, system perspective. The main relationships within and between the building blocks constituting the ICTS are mapped and evaluated from three aspects: the domestic sectoral relationships, the innovative capability and the international trade advantage. The ICT's most important downstream relationships have extended from manufacturing sectors to construction and service sectors, showing a more widely use. Both of ICT export value and relative bilateral advantages in the main import countries have increased rapidly since 2002. Although the patents number and share have increased rapidly at the same time, there is no relative technological advantage in Chinese ICT. When other ICT leaders are considered together, it shows an interesting convergence of the technology specialization. The inconsistency of the trade advantage and technology disadvantage indicates that low technology involved in Chinese ICT products. It is a great challenge for China to transit from low-cost manufacturing to higher value-added goods and services.

articleTitle: New thoughts about supply chain security after 9-11 terrorist attack
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Before Sept.11, 2001, the question "what is supply-chain security" would surely have brought out the more traditional areas of risk management-natural and man-made disasters; equipment and infrastructure failures; regulatory requirements; loss prevention; geopolitical events; and personnel strikes. Today, especially after the attacks of Sept. 11, supply chain security has taken on a whole new level of meaning and immediacy. It's now a primary consideration that needs to be addressed as comprehensively as any other part of running the business. And accordingly, it needs to undergo the same rigorous economic analysis as any other key activity. This paper discusses the problem of supply chain security from five aspects, it starts from brief introduction, and then, discusses the importance of security strategy within the supply chain, next, six steps of conducting security management were analyzed; Fourth, the impacts of conducting supply chain security management on different members within supply chain were categorized into three category; finally, all the discussions were brought to an natural conclusion.

articleTitle: Study on logistics service recovery system based on service profit chain
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The uncertainty inherent in logistics makes the service failure unavoidable. Once the service failure occurs, the service recovery will become the necessary line of defense within the service profit chain. The establishment of logistics service recovery system based on service profit chain aims to promote the sustainable development of logistics enterprises by implementing service recovery timely and improving service quality, and push the enterprise into the sustainable 'Service Profit Cycle'.The thesis analyses the mechanism of logistics service failure from the viewpoint of service profit chain, and proposes the general model of logistics service recovery system, which may provide reference for logistics enterprises.

articleTitle: A linkage of Markdown Pricing with aggregate production planning
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper is to study the significance of the cooperation between the markdown policy and the aggregate planning so as to simulate the cooperation between retailers and manufacturers. A fuzzy nonlinear programming model, named Aggregate Production Planning-Markdown Pricing Model (APP-MP), is established by integrating the markdown model into Aggregate Production Planning model. Due to the uncertainty of business information and environment, some cost elements are considered to be fuzzy number so that the objective function is fuzzy in nature. The fuzzy programming model is transformed into a crisp parametric model to be solved. The parametric APP-MP is able to help the retailer and the manufacturer flexibly make the pricing decisions, including the magnitude and time of markdown, and production decisions based on different satisfaction levels so that greater profits could be obtained. The example solution shows that the cooperation definitely increases the profits.

articleTitle: On the performance evaluation of 3PL using subtractive clustering based RBFNN and UDM
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Nowadays, the application of neural network technology in the evaluation of Third party logistics (3PL) is very limited in China. The reason lies in the difficulty to find high quality training samples for neural network self-learning. This paper adopts Uniform Design Method (UDM) to design representative, uniform and large-scale samples. And then use those samples to train the subtractive clustering based Radial Basis Function neural network (SC-RBFNN) which is applied to carry out the 3PL Evaluation. The result of the experiment shows that the generalization ability of the subtractive clustering algorithm based RBFNN combined with UDM is far better than that of traditional RBFNN. This method not only has the ability of determining the number of clusters and their values automatically and realizes non-linear approaching, but also conquers the performance limitations of traditional RBFNN. Moreover it avoids the subjectivity and uncertainty of traditional evaluation.

articleTitle: Analysis on integration efficiency of port cluster resources based on DEA model
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: At present, Shandong government brings forward the strategic objective of building Qingdao into the international shipping center. But because the port resources have not been effectively integrated, redundant construction and vicious competition still exist which constrain the port development. This paper will discuss the port integration mechanism by applying DEA model, set up corresponding evaluation system, and evaluate the effect of integration of port cluster resources of Shandong Peninsula. On this basis, against the status quo of port resources of Shandong province, we give some measures and suggestions of integration, and providing decision-making reference to the port resources of port cluster resources of Shandong Peninsula.

articleTitle: Analysis on merchandise hierarchy via clustering retail records
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Merchandise hierarchy plays an important role in modern retail business. In this paper, we suggest a quantitative consumer-related evaluation method of merchandise hierarchy via clustering the retail records. The retail records contains much information reflecting the consumer buying behavior, and it should be effectively utilized to judge whether a predefined merchandise hierarchy is appropriate for a specific retailer's business. Here, we mainly mine the complementary information between products from the retail records, that reflect some crucial consumer buying habits and can be used to evaluate predefined merchandise hierarchy.
