The pragmatic Grid is an extension of the semantic Grid, to concern with how the Grid information can be used effectively according to user purpose and context. In this paper, we propose pragmatic Grid architecture, pragmatic information model, architecture of interoperation for resource management, and a pragmatic-aware discovery service. Finally, a case study is given to validate the applicability of personalized resources discovery in pragmatic Grid.

articleTitle: Vehicle routing optimization problem with time constraint using advanced PBIL algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The intelligent optimization algorithm PBIL is applied to VRP. Faced to the concrete problem that the objective function is to minimize the cost and meet the time restriction. And the probability statistics for the road traffic status distributed in working hours is considered to decide the routing. The probability matrix of PBIL algorithm is modified with the quick velocity update strategy of particle swarm optimization algorithm. The modified PBIL algorithm is tested in a Beijing Stone Logistics Company. The good adaptability, validity and stability performance are fully shown by the results.

articleTitle: Utility maximization scheme for end-to-end QoS routing in communication networks with heterogeneous service classes
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: We present an integer programming approach to offer optimal bandwidth allocation and QoS routing for network management problems with heterogeneous service classes. The bandwidth allocation policy in such communication networks is determined in accordance with the proportionally fair rule, which can be expressed by utility functions of network users. The objective of this utility maximization scheme is to prepare a routing table for future user request. This routing table identifies the allocated bandwidth and the suitable end-to-end path under QoS guarantees for each user. We analyze the mathematical properties of the optimal bandwidth allocation and provide computational results to demonstrate the validity and efficiency of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Research on formation mechanism of X Party Material Flow: Rebuilding of PMF primitive
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The Material flow model taking enterprise or strategy business unit (SBU) as a whole for division of work and cooperation, in nature, is a second-best combination of the capability factors of material flow. By making full use of modern information technology and science progress, the division of work in material flow shall be detailed to the level of PMF primitive, for the purpose of the cross-organization and cross-industry rebuilding and optimizing, and a new model of material organizing - X Party Material Flow (X-PMF) was formed thereby, which will minimize the cost of production and transaction, and increase the comprehensive efficiency of the material flow of supply chain.

articleTitle: Logistics network in sparsely populated area - A case of logistics network between Southern and Northern parts of Norway with Narvik as conjunction point
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: A logistics network is `connective tissue' in a comprehensive supply chain and often the decisive factor for the chain's ultimate success. Logistics networks in sparsely populated areas are facing different challenges than those that operating in relatively densely inhabited ones. This paper discusses, firstly, various critical success factors of logistics network. The challenges of operating a logistics network in sparsely populated areas are identified and discussed. A case study is being conducted in the context of a region in Northern Norway where the average population rate is 4.3 persons each square kilometer. The paper suggests that, by combining reverse with forward logistics networks in Northern Norway, economic and environmental sustainable logistics networks can be achieved. The challenges of integrating forward and reverse logistics networks in the area of Northern Norway are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on logistics service operation model of industrial clusters: Zhejiang Province as an example
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: As the development of industrial clusters, relevant firms has been promoted to gathering. Consequently, plenty of logistic operations emerged along the supply chain, where raw materials and finished products flow in and out of the clusters frequently. Thus, the operation of logistics service may restrict the industrial clusters' radiation effects to a great extent. It is significantly important to establish an effective and low-cost logistics service system to improve the competitive advantage of industrial clusters. In this article, five typical logistics service models of industrial clusters were presented, based on the research in Zhejiang Province.

articleTitle: Study of optimizing the knowledge acquisition route based on core-corporation in supply chain
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: How to optimize the knowledge flow on supply chain has become a research focus of the study on supply chain. From the perspective of core-corporations on supply chain, this paper describes the flow path as to how the core-corporations acquire knowledge and builds optimization model of the efficiency of knowledge acquisition, with the cost and the increment of knowledge as variables, in the hope of improving the flow efficiency of knowledge by utilizing the core-corporations as major drivers on supply chain and eventually enhancing the core competence and the general efficiency of supply chain. Finally the paper verifies the feasibility of this method with examples.

articleTitle: Capability sharing architecture and implementation in IM or SNS
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Current IM or SNS system provides a way for users to send message, talk, and share pictures and so on among buddies. However, it's not easy to share an application or other resources among the buddies. A user cannot use the resources in other devices which are lacked locally in run time, but sometimes that is what users want. This paper describes a new and potential Web 3.0 or Web 2.0 plus application to share the capability of different computers or devices among buddies in IM or SNS system. It provides an easy way for each buddy device to advertise their capability, automatically discover other buddy devices' capability and share the capabilities.

articleTitle: The impact of lead time on supply risk based on multi-agent simulation
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Supply risk is one of the operation risks in the supply chain, Thomas Kull found that increasing inventory in a tiered supply chain can sometimes increase supply risk. Well how supply risk is affected by lead time in the presence of supply failure? By evaluating risk in a simulation environment based on multi-agent technology, exploratory findings suggest that increasing lead time in a multi-echelon supply chain can sometimes decrease supply risk of downstream and own but increase that of competitors.

articleTitle: Knowledge management in collaborative design
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: To enhance the product development ability of enterprise, collaborative design is applied to new product development. Knowledge management among designers is an important problem for collaborative design. A computerized knowledge management system for collaborative product development is present to solve the problem. A framework of knowledge management based on ontology is present. The collaborative knowledge is introduced to assist to acknowledge the process of collaborative design. Knowledge based on ontology is constructed, which is the critical part of system. It can solve the problem of the knowledge sharing and knowledge application. At last, the framework of knowledge management system is constructed, which integrate the knowledge management with collaborative design process. The framework can realize the knowledge capture and reuse to enhance the efficiency of design.

articleTitle: A Service-Oriented Architecture framework for the distributed concurrent and collaborative design
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The independent development capabilities of the new products reflect the core competitiveness of enterprises. The concurrent and collaborative design for complex product is a new mode of design based on concurrent engineering and multidisciplinary collaborative design, using various fields of CAX/DFx. At present, the most advanced collaborative work technology is based on the Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA). According to the theory of concurrent engineering and the optimization theory in the multidisciplinary collaborative design, the paper defines the concept of DCCD-distributed concurrent and collaborative design. Based on SOA and the distributed services environment, this paper first presents a novel distributed concurrent and collaborative design platform architecture. The architecture integrates some Large-scale commercial engineering softwares (such as Pro/E, HaperMesh and ANSYS) to quickly accomplish the design and analysis of complex product. Using the java programming language, this paper defines the interface description of the services and gives detailed introductions to the architecture by a demonstration of railway bogie. Compared with the traditional collaborative design platform, this architecture can shorten the cycle of service exchange, and strongly support concurrent and collaborative design for the complex product.

articleTitle: Impacts of organizational innovation capability and leadership styles on innovation performance for electronics information industry in Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: In the age of globally competitive market, enterprise must keep upgrading by building innovation capability to avoid phasing out from the market. Organizational innovation capability under a suitable leadership style leads to good innovation performance. 149 employees of listed and OTC electronics information companies in Taiwan are chosen as sampling subject. We use AMOS 6.0 statistical software to test the hypotheses we develop. The findings are as follows: (1) organizational innovation capability has a positive impact on organizational innovation performance, (2) the leadership style has a positive relationship on organizational innovation performance, and (3) the leadership style moderates the relationship between organizational innovation capability and organizational innovation performance.

articleTitle: A Lagrangian Relaxation based heuristic approach for steel grade assignment problem
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper investigates the steel grade assignment problem daily encountered in the iron and steel industry, which involves the determination of which candidate steel grades to be employed in order to satisfy as many collective customer orders as possible such that the number of employing new steel grades and the desirable costs of satisfying the customer orders from the employed steel grade are minimized. The problem is formulated as a mixed integer programming model in which customer orders are optional. In addition, it displays the characteristic of the uncapacitated facility location problem. A midpoint-based method is proposed to obtain the desirable costs for the ability of steel grades to satisfy the requirements of orders. We develop a Lagrangian Relaxation based (LR-based) heuristic approach with hybrid improvements including local search for the problem. The algorithm has been tested on instances collected from practical production data. Computational results demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach even for realistic problems with larger instances.

articleTitle: Safety performance evaluation of highway intersection based upon traffic flow theories
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The unique characteristics of highway intersections have caused them to be the most dangerous places in the road system. Complexity of causes of traffic crashes at highway intersections, difficulty in data collection of traffic accidents and traffic conflicts and many other reasons have made safety performance evaluation of highway intersections one of the most difficult tasks, in spite of the fact that studies on it have been carried out for quite a long time. Popular methods which are based upon traffic accidents and traffic conflicts are proved to be effective in certain circumstances, but difficulty in data collection of traffic crashes and subjective judgment and determination of traffic conflicts constrain their applications. Supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China, this paper aims to set up a new approach to safety performance evaluation of highway intersections by application of traffic flow theories. Based on systematic analysis of causes of traffic accidents at highway intersections, the safety performance evaluation models take the form of possibility estimation of serious traffic conflicts. The models are efficient though their mathematical expressions are simple. By analysis of the models, some meaningful conclusions are drawn toward improvement of safety performance of highway intersection.

articleTitle: Assessing performance reliability of transportation networks under demand and supply uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper proposes a new approach to access the network performance considering both travel time and its reliability in transportation networks with demand and supply uncertainties. Due to such uncertainties, travel times are no longer deterministic and so they can be viewed as random variables. The corresponding mean, variance and covariance between link travel times are deduced by an analytical method using a modified travel time function. Confronted with travel time variations travelers are assumed to allow an extra travel time, known in the literature, a safety margin, for their journeys to improve the likelihood of punctual arrival. Under this condition, the effective travel time, which is defined as the summation of mean travel time and safety margin, is adopted as the traveler's path choice criteria. Then, the corresponding reliability-based traffic assignment problem is formulated as a variational inequality (VI) problem. And the resultant total effective travel time is proposed as the measure for evaluating the network performance on both travel time and its reliability. Such VI problem can be solved by an employed heuristic solution algorithm. The numerical results indicate that travel time variations increase as the network environment becomes more uncertain in demand and supply. It is also evidenced by the numerical results that the newly proposed performance measure is more applicable than conventional measure, particularly for networks with demand and supply uncertainties.

articleTitle: A treatment method for urban rail transport project benefit information to ensure the multiple benefit factors based on rough set
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Ensuring the weight of benefit factors is an important process of urban rail transport projects benefit analysis. Based on the analysis of similar methods and studies, the paper points out the existing problem in researches on urban rail transportation project of the single benefit factor through either traditional methods or rough set. Therefore, theory of rough set is used to set up models of multiple benefit factors in urban rail transport project. At last, empirical analysis is carried out which provides supports for urban rail transportation project management and decision.

articleTitle: Supply chain control model: A cybernetics-based approach
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Only under the control of supply chain, the enterprises in the supply chain can cooperate totally and achieve the goal of management efficiently. This article has made research on the control of supply chain based on cybernetics. It firstly defines supply chain control, supply chain control system and other related concepts. Then puts forward the components of supply chain control system, and analyze the mechanism and the process of supply chain control.

articleTitle: Research on the expanded TMF eTOM framework and case study
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: As we know, TMF eTOM framework has been widely accepted, but we still have some doubt about the real value in applying eTOM to telecom operation, which is mainly because that eTOM does not include a reasonable consideration of organizational levels. Organizational level is an important factor that it can bring demand on operation support and management improvement which are remarkable and general in enterprise operation. In this paper, we present "break point section" (BP section) to expand eTOM framework. BP Section can give a clear description of the function and related issues of organizational levels in telecom operation system. With this expansion and improvement, Expanded-eTOM framework not only retains the original basic functions but also reflects relations and interactions between organizational level and core value-creating activity and end-to-end process, achieving to reflect the organizational level factor in eTOM framework. Additionally, this paper uses a case study-infrastructure lifecycle management research on a mobile telecom operator- to explain the value of such expansion on eTOM framework.

articleTitle: The research of the city transportation development ecological carrying capacity based on the system dynamics
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: To study the relations between the transportation development and ecological environment may has the vital significance to the transportation long-enduring development. The domestic and foreign research about transportation development ecological carrying capacity has been mentioned when studies the region ecological carrying capacity, on which hasn't specially concentrated research. The paper elaborates the implication of the city transportation development ecological carrying capacity, unifying the definition and the characteristic of ecological carrying capacity. In view of the city transportation development actuality, the development of urban transportation system is divided into five subsystems. The system dynamics analysis method has been carried on the structure analysis to the city transportation development ecological carrying capacity. Simulation software 'Vensim' is used to analyze each subsystem and get the feedback loop. Then SD equation of each subsystem is established. Finally, in example analysis, applying the relevant statistical data in Wuhan city to the SD equation, the ecological carrying capacity development tendency of each subsystem is simulated. The research would have a referenced role to the city transportation coordinated development within the scope of the ecological carrying capacity.

articleTitle: Modeling the relationship between supply chain integration and integrated supply chain performance
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: A positive relationship between supply chain integration and integrated supply chain performance is often suggested in the supply chain literature. However, extant research has focused more on the investigation of the impacts of supply chain integration on corporate performance, and especially performance of the focal firm, rather than supply chain-wide performance. Moreover, the definition and measurement of the two above mentioned concepts varies significantly within the extant research, thus reducing comparability of results. The objective of this paper is to present a conceptual model for investigating the relationship between supply chain integration and integrated supply chain performance. The constructs of the model are described, appropriate metrics for the assessment of the constructs are proposed and propositions for examining the linkages among the constructs are developed.

articleTitle: A study on some system safety with geometric process repairs
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: A 3-state Markov model is used to model some safety-critical systems, when the system states can be divided into three kinds of categories: Operating States, Failed-Safe States & Failed-Unsafe States. These models are used to estimate the system safety and security. Based on these models, a new model is built when the system fails, different defect states have different measures. For Failed-Safe States, the repair process is adopted and for the other failed states is not. The repeatedly repairs have some influences on the operating times, repair times and the coverage to different failed states. Geometric Process is employed to describe this repair process and get some indexes of the system safety.

articleTitle: Study of application on Verhulst-Markov chain combination forecasting model
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Grey model and Markov chain are integrated to forecast the tendency of saturation or sigmoid where the precision testified in the case is much more accurate than that of other methods. Thus, the combination forecasting model applies to predict things concretely combined with highway passenger volume development in Guangdong province. Proved in theory and practice, the forecast results not only are more accurate, adaptable, practical but also can help the decision maker with grasping the highway passenger volume development tendency in general and making proper decision.

articleTitle: An applied study on the method for supplier selection with PCA and ELECTRE
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: With globalization and the emergence of the extended enterprise of interdependent organizations, there has been a steady increase in good suppliers' demands. This leads firms to give more importance to the purchasing function and its associated decisions. The process of supplier selection is very complex in the supply chain management, which includes both qualitative and quantitative factors, and belongs to the category of multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM). During recent years, how to determine suitable suppliers has become a key strategic consideration. In this paper, the methods of Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and ELECTRE are mainly studied to select suppliers scientifically. First, evaluation indexes for supplier selection are constructed; second, epurating these quantitative and qualitative indexes is finished by the method of PCA; last, the suitable one can be selected from all those suppliers by the method of ELECTRE. This paper shows that the proposed process is very well suited as a decision-making combinatorial tool for supplier selection decisions.

articleTitle: Research the strategy of the highway transportation in the earthquake
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The paper present two models to analyze this problem of the highway transportation and investigate what strategies can reduce the traffic congestion, which brought about by the earthquake. The models can provide better understanding of the congestion and give advice to the solution of this problem by making full use of the road network. Firstly the paper discuss what measurements can be used to judge a strategy of evacuation, which is from the disaster area to safety areas. Secondly develop a graph-based maximum-flow model and find how to achieve the maximum traffic flow from the disaster areas to the safety areas. In the finally, combining the current earthquake in Sichuan of China, the paper get the best solution of transport the casualties by highway in the least time. The result show that the method presented in this paper is very useful.

articleTitle: Towards a supply chain analysis framework
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Coordination between supply chain organizations on strategic, tactical and operation levels leads to more effective and efficient supply chains. For a supply chain coordination process a systems approach together with broad understanding of relevant supply chain management issues is necessary. Supply chain managers must speak the same language and be able to gain mutual understanding of possible supply chain problems. As part of the development a post-academic course in supply chain management a supply chain analysis framework has been developed and used in a case situation. This framework supports the analysis for supply chains and facilitates the finding of options to make supply chains more effective and efficient.

articleTitle: The integrated modeling and framework of clinical pathway adaptive workflow management system based on Extended Workflow-nets (EWF-nets)
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: At present, the clinical pathways (CP) is developed and implemented manually by filling predefined paper. Computerization and automatic or semi-automatic implementation of CP based on workflow is one of the possible solutions. By introducing the rule places based on object-oriented Petri net, we build the CP workflow model to solve the workflow route decision-making. However, there are still some unavoidable and frequent variations in the execution process of CP. Therefore, this paper presents the framework of clinical pathway adaptive workflow management system (CPWAMS) based on extended workflow-nets(EWF-nets). And the integrated modeling is established to describe communicating with and exchanging the medical information among the disparate medical systems (HIS, RIS, PACS and LIS) during the computerized clinical pathway executing.

articleTitle: Services innovation transforming B2B gateway
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The objective of collaborative Business-to-Business (B2B) technologies is to minimize the gap between the trading partners. In the early 80s, the need for interactions among companies and their trading partners led to the development of Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) which for many years has been the most dependable way for companies to exchange B2B documents. However the deep learning curve and the cost of the required resources to support EDI prevented Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) to adopt the technology in the automated trading processes. ebXML was introduced to overcome the excising shortcomings of EDI, but has its own limitations mainly reflected in its capability in providing decision support analysis and large scale concurrent applications. In this paper, a distributed user centric B2B gateway approach is presented to support trading partners. The gateway takes the leverages of services innovation integrating resources from traditional e-business environments with loosely coupled decision support resources to complete trading intelligently. The Australian retail sector has been chosen as an application domain in understanding the impact of the proposed solution.

articleTitle: Study on traffic safety, efficiency and intervention in weaving area
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: As the important part of interchange, weaving area is the accident-prone and bottleneck of urban expressway because of a lot of weaving operations, where the traffic flow is needed to be intervened in order to improve the safety and efficiency. This paper divides traffic intervention measures into three kinds: driver behavior intervention, road condition intervention and traffic flow intervention, and studies the relationship between traffic flow intervention and traffic safety, efficiency under different demand. Conflict rate, traffic flow rate, delay per vehicle of weaving section and ramp are selected as the indices to analyze traffic safety and efficiency under three common intervention measures respectively, i.e. yield sign, speed limit and ramp metering. Finally, taking an example for Youyi Avenue interchange of Wuhan Yangtze River Tunnel, it analyzes how the traffic safety and efficiency changes under the condition of certain design property and different interventions in weaving area, and confirms the intervention measure in different traffic demand.

articleTitle: A quality control of the injection molding process using EWMA predictor and minimum-variance controller
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: In this study, EWMA (exponentially weighted moving average) predictor and minimum-variance controller were applied to improve the product quality in the injection molding process. To simplify the process model and reduce the system loads, design of experiments (DOE) technique was adopted to analyze the important factors which have the significant effects on the product quality and their relative correlations. The results of this research not only can steadily control the manufacturing process and reduce the product loss and maintenance time for un-warning malfunction, but can also increase the efficiency of the equipment and the process.

articleTitle: Air cargo load planning
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: For a multiple-segment flight of passenger aircraft, air cargo load planning is the trade-off between operation time, mishandling ratio, and load factor. A rule-based optimization approach is adopted by us to model the complex business logic. In the load planning, there are several atomic actions, which is relatively stable and linked together by rule flow. This paper discusses the optimization algorithms behind these actions. The system has been successfully applied in a North American airline company.

articleTitle: Study on stablity for the growth of Virtual Enterprise lifecycle based on the self-organization theory
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: In the current fierce competitive market, the establishment of Virtual Enterprises has become an effective strategic approach in the evolution process of which many complex phenomena. Based on self-organization theory, this paper focuses on analyzing the relationship between dissipative factors in the outside world and how close the relationship between the partners in Virtual Enterprise and gives a new interpretation for the growth of Virtual enterprise lifecycle. Furthermore, this paper sets up a dynamic evolution model for Virtual Enterprise stability and experiments analysis.

articleTitle: An ant colony algorithm for the sequential testing problem under precedence constraints
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: We consider the problem of minimum cost sequential testing of a series (parallel) system under precedence constraints that can be modeled as a nonlinear integer program. We develop and implement an ant colony algorithm for the problem. We demonstrate the performance of this algorithm for special type of instances for which the optimal solutions can be found in polynomial time. In addition, we compare the performance of the algorithm with a special branch and bound algorithm for general instances. The ant colony algorithm is shown to be particularly effective for larger instances of the problem.

articleTitle: Integrated short-term staffing and long-term resource action planning for services projects
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: In a portfolio of services projects, each project manager delivers a resource request to the resource deployment manager. The request is in the form of a network of activities, where each activity can be staffed at multiple levels of resource-staffing using various skill-types. Each level of staffing implies a specific duration for the activity and, hence, the project. Activities can be either immediately staffed with specific resources, or planned for, with respect to future needs depending on their timing in the horizon of interest. We propose an integrated method to address both the immediate short term staffing level, and the planned, long term staffing level for a portfolio of requests using two-time-scale optimization formulation. In the short-term, the level of staffing for each immediate activity is decided for each project request, subject to short-term resource availability in each skill type and substitutability among skill types. In the long-term, a planned level of staffing for each of the corresponding activities within each project request is decided, to further carry out a resource action planning exercise. The resource action considers regular hiring, contracting and cross-training among skill types.

articleTitle: Measure of ERP users' satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: It is very difficult in measuring the success of Enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems. Key-users' satisfaction is often used as substitute variable to determine the ERP's success. This study found out that relationship exists between key-user satisfaction and perceived ERP success in China. Especially, the model adopts three factors of the first level one, and i5 items of the second level. The three factors were correlated and the correlations are statistically caused by the second-level factor. ERP suppliers should concentrate on concerned about the quality of products and improvement of user knowledge. ERP users should carefully select suppliers and service personnel.

articleTitle: Value at risk for repo interest rate based on TGARCH
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: There is a great significance to research the interest rate risk on the background of China's gradual marketization of interest rates. The paper takes the 7 days repo interest rates as the target. First, introduce the calculating method for value at risk. Second, give the sample characters and the dynamic model of the 7 days repo interest rate. Third, using the GARCH and TGARCH model, at 99% confidence level and 95% confidence level, calculate the value at risk and the exception rate for the 7 days repo interest rates. The empirical results show that the value at risk of 7days repo interest rate has positive correlation with the level of interest rates, and whatever at 95% confidence level or at 99% confidence level, both GARCH model and TGARCH model can cover the real forecasting losses, and the exception rate is lower than the significance level.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient schedule for object detection in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) have attracted a lot of research attention which consist of a large number of sensors. Sensors are capable of sensing, processing and transmitting environmental information. Data collection and object detection are two main applications in WSNs. In this paper, object detection has been studied. By detecting persistent object and ephemeral object, we investigate in detail the fundamental relationship of object detection probability and detection delay with different nodes density and sensing range. For wireless sensor networks are composed of power-restrained nodes that limit their lifetime, energy-efficiency is a key concern in WSNs. Balancing object detection quality and network lifetime is a challenging task in sensor networks. We also launched a novelty energy-aware wake up scheme, which significantly prolongs the life of WSNs and increases the detection performance of wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: Human recognition based on head-shoulder moment feature
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Aimed at the shortcomings of the traditional visual surveillance system, the automatic detection and recognition algorithm of human are studied in Intelligent Monitoring System. This paper uses the moment eigenvector of head-shoulder's contour as the back-propagation (BP) neural network's input for human identification by building the 2D model of human head-shoulder. Because of adopting the partial contour shape of the human rather than whole features, it has a better classification on solving the issue of the loss of property arising from human occluded easily in practical applications. At the same time, the mapping relation of 'feature - class' is established by error back-propagation neural network classifier, which completes identification of human. The experiment's result shows that this method is effective, and it has strong robustness.

articleTitle: The effect study of trade protection on trade flows and trade order of Chinese textiles
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper firstly started with the happening basis of international trade, discussed the impact mechanism of the trade protection on China's trade flows, and adopted economic model to explain the effect mechanism; Secondly, the paper also analyzed the likely impact on China's textile trade flows of the regional trade agreements signed by United States, EU and the third countries as well as the welfare changes of all the counties by the trade flows transfer; Finally, it analyzed the trade protection impact on illegal entrepot trade, rent-seeking and short-term behavior of China's textiles.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of a single-station MTO/MTS hybrid production system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: We consider an single-station production system that produces standard products for ordinary demands and custom products for specific demands. Custom products are made by alternating the existing standard ones from inventory with additional works and base-stock control policy is applied to control the production of the standard product. In this system, the production of the custom products for specific demands has higher priority than the production of the standard product. The fill rate of the ordinary demand and the on-time-delivery-rate of the specific demand are considered as the measures of the qualities of service. By assuming a Markovian system, qualities of service under base-stock policy are derived; furthermore, the optimal base-stock level can be obtained numerically under the requirements on the qualities of services.

articleTitle: Multi-event complex logistics network model
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Recently a networking trend is emerging in the development of modern logistics. The logistics network (LN) is complex society network with complex form and mechanism. More and more scholars have paid their attention to the study to LN. In this paper, we present a growing network model adapted to LN practice, then use it to theoretic researches, which has enrich and improve the original model proposed by R. Alert and A-L. Barabási. We have not only proved that the degree distribution of such complex logistics network has be power-law, but also introduce and analyze some parameters in the model in order to help people to understand the real logistics network distinctly. At last, we hope the paper will introduce a new angle of view to network complexity research in logistics field.

articleTitle: A manpower supply planning model for MRT carriage maintenance
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: In this study, we develop a manpower supply planning model for mass rapid transit carriage maintenance under mixed deterministic and stochastic. The model and the method used currently in actual operations are evaluated by a simulation-based evaluation method. Finally, we perform a case study using real operating data from a Taiwan MRT maintenance facility. The preliminary results are good, showing that the model could be useful for planning carriage maintenance manpower supply.

articleTitle: Combinational evaluation on the competitiveness of logistics enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Evaluation of competitiveness is the strategic choice for the logistics enterprise. In this paper a new framework of combinational evaluation methodology based on statistics is constructed. At first the Kendall coefficient of consistency is computed to identify whether the different single evaluation methods are compatible. A nonlinear program is constructed to determine the weight of different evaluation method result. The effect of the combinational method is determined with the index of MAPE and MSPE. Then competitiveness of logistics enterprise are evaluated with the combinational evaluation method. The evaluation index system is constructed. Composite index, TOPSIS, efficiency coefficient method and factor analysis are chosen to take evaluation. Based on above 4 single evaluation methods, combinational evaluation is constructed with the nonlinear program. The explorative results show that combinational evaluation method is a kind of good evaluation method.

articleTitle: An analysis on the relationship between modern logistics and e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Because of its importance to the circulation of commodities, modern logistics has become the focus of the governments and enterprises. On the other hand, e-commerce has brought immense impact to the traditional commodity circulation with its brand-new style of commercial activities, and has become an essential subject for enterprises both in production and in circulation. This paper tries to sum up the characteristics of modern logistics and e-commerce, and analyze the inter-dependent, inter-contributive relationship between modern logistics and e-commerce.

articleTitle: Research for Dynamic vehicle routing problem with time windows in real city environment
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: In this paper a dynamic vehicle routing problem with time windows is described where both the influence of real-time road traffic and random customer demand are considered. In order to approaching real complex city environment, a simulation model constructed by both computer simulation method and improved ant colony optimization is proposed in this paper. A fresh food distribution of local chain store in real city environment is researched. The application results prove that the model is effective and efficient.

articleTitle: A method for modeling generalized distance functions
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: We propose a method for modeling distance functions in an n dimensional Euclidean space such that, for each ordered pair of distinct points there is at least one path connecting them. Our distance functions may refer to transportation cost, travel distance, travel time, energy expended, etc. We introduce two new concepts: generalized distance function (gdf) and are induced by a gdf. A gdf, unlike metrics, can be asymmetric and nonpositive definite, and unlike Lp metrics, it can be nonuniform. We show that a gdf can be obtained by solving a problem of the calculus of variations, where the value of the functional for a given arc joining two points represents the length of the arc measured with respect to that gdf. We obtain a gdf with physical interpretation.

articleTitle: Design of a cooperative organization for a machine's life cycle based service provision
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Since the industrial market has developed largely from national into international, the products from mass production to customized individual production, as well as the customer requirements, which have changed from cost-driven to availability-driven, certain circumstances can be figured out. The enterprises are partly forced to pay attention to the life cycle of machines. On that account, the industrial service is becoming more and more important for customers and enterprises in order to enhance the machine's availability.

articleTitle: Study on the model of service quality gap in urban rail transit
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: There is a certain extent practical significance to find effective ways to upgrade the service quality of urban rail transit service management, and to improve efficiency of public transport operation and satisfaction by offering service product. This paper uses the model of service quality gap to analysis the five kinds of gaps of urban rail transit service quality, find operating enterprise's quality standards, external publicity, and other issues and target the solutions.

Author Keywords: the model of service quality gap

articleTitle: The impact of service quality and relationship quality on E-shop brand image
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: With the rapid development of internet, shopping online has become one of the mainstream patterns for consumption. As E-consumers will not trust and go shopping from E-shops so easily, building up a good brand image for E-shop to gain the trust from E-consumers become very necessary. Based on 143 questionnaires from Chinese netizens who have the E-shopping experience, this paper implements a structural equation model to test whether and how service quality and relationship quality with E-consumers take effect on the establishment of E-shop brand image. The result shows that service quality has direct positive impact on relationship quality with E-consumers but no direct positive impact on E-shop brand image. In addition, relationship quality plays an intermediary role between service quality and E-shop brand image, and has direct positive impact on E-shop brand image, which indicates that relationship quality is very important to E-shop for brand image building up and increasing E-consumers' buying frequencies.

articleTitle: Constructing IT contingency planning based on RUP model
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Contingency planning generates a preventable mechanism to maintain continuity of support for IT field. Several steps are needed in the process of constructing contingency planning to ensure the effectiveness and precise. These steps are organized not separately but logically and systematically. Method of software engineering is available for use. Rational unified process (RUP) is adopted and developed to be a general method and policy.

articleTitle: A solution to interval linear bi-level programming and its application in decentralized supply chain planning
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Decentralized supply chain planning problems naturally combine multiple decision steps, which are connected in a hierarchical way. Different participants usually have incomplete information for various reasons, such as ego-defense. In this paper, the linear bi-level programming with interval coefficients in lower level objective function is formulated as an extension of the classical linear bi-level problem under an inexact environment. The best solution, best value and best coefficients are defined, respectively. Moreover, a method based on Kth-best algorithm is employed to solve the problem; the coefficients' impact on solution is analyzed, and a numerical example is presented to illustrate effectiveness of the present method. Finally, advantages of the method in decentralized supply chain planning are discussed.

articleTitle: Constructing input-output table for Beijing urban mass transit
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The input-output table can provide a large quantity of effective and reliable data support for the analysis of industrial economy. However, currently, the urban input-output table issued every five years has not covered the urban mass transit industry. The present paper discusses the urban transit structure, separating the urban mass transit of Beijing as an independent department from the input-output table of Beijing based on the data of the volume and ticket revenue of Beijing metro. The paper analyses, designs and calculates the input-output table of Beijing urban mass transit and makes contributions to the calculation and analysis of the studies on the status, role and contributions of Beijing urban mass transit in the regional economy of Beijing city.

articleTitle: Reliability of k-out-of-n:G system in supply chain based on Markov chain
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: From the point of the process of distribution service, a Markov chain based method is proposed for analyzing the reliability of supply chain. This paper presents an analytic method for determining the reliability of supply chains for logistics systems. By introducing the model of k -out-of- n :G system in reliability into the studies of supply chain, an evaluation method is suggested. And the reliability of distribution service is obtained when the distribution center operates steadily. These indexes have practical and significant meaning for evaluating the supply chain system reliability performance and can also be used to improve the reliability management.

articleTitle: Drive analysis of logistics outsourcing based on systemic and environmental factor framework
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: At present, the logistics outsourcing has gradually become a main operational scheme of the logistics service organizational strategy and it is an effective way for enterprises to integrate their external resources. In order to give a comprehensive analysis on the enterprise logistics outsourcing actions from the perspective of the system resources integration, to analyze the main drives of the enterprise logistics outsourcing and their impact degree to the outsourcing actions from the related systemic and environmental factor framework about the enterprise operations, we give survey and analysis to the entity enterprises requiring the logistics outsourcing services. On this basis, by using the related analysis methods of statistics, we make a comparative analysis on the enterprise logistics outsourcing drives from the systemic and environmental factor framework and draw some conclusions in order to give references to plan and guide the actions of the enterprise logistics outsourcing and standardize the orders of the logistics outsourcing market.

articleTitle: How to improve the efficiency of railway freight transport in the urban area? Lessons from Los Angeles Alameda rail cargo expressway
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The Los Angeles Alameda rail cargo expressway, which cost about 2.4 billion US dollars and took more than 25 years for planning and construction, has illuminated that by using the advantage of the transportation geographical location, consolidating rail routes resources and constructing a 20-mile railroad trench and 43 grade separations, the railroad system may successfully integrate to the urban multi-modal transportation system and to the urban fabric. This innovation of the freight transportation makes the urban railroads become the important propelling force but hindrances for urban development. This paper takes this as a case, introducing basic situation of the Alameda rail cargo expressway and the evolution of corridor's plan and construction process. Further, this rail corridor's important effects to the Los Angeles' urban area are analyzed. And, the paper summarizes the key lessons, for the big urban, how to make use of railroad in the urban multi-modal transportation system, to improve the freight transport efficiency in urban region, to eliminate the conflicts between the railroads and the city surface transportation, and to cut off the congestion in urban area. The conclusion of this paper includes some principles for improving the effciency of railway freight transport in urban area and provides the important ideas and the practice experices for development of urban freight transport in China.

articleTitle: Research on the model of risk identification of container logistics outsourcing based factor analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: When bringing the enterprises competitive and beneficial advantages, the container logistics outsourcing also brings them lots of risks. Container logistics outsourcing risks are caused by many factor, these factors also have their own fuzzy. Therefore, its risk factor for effective identification is the foundation and prerequisite of container logistics outsourcing risk management. Based on the container logistics outsourcing risk characteristics, the model of risk identification for container logistics outsourcing based on the factor analysis is established. The risk factors of container logistics outsourcing are selected through the Delphi method firstly, then, the key risk factors of container logistics outsourcing are identified using SPSS software and factor analysis model. Finally, a use of the model example shows that the model is easy to operate, simple and practical advantages.

articleTitle: Prioritizing design requirement in fuzzy quality function deployment
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Quality function deployment (QFD) is a customer-oriented design tool for developing new or improved products to increase customer satisfaction. QFD focuses on delivering value by taking into account customer needs and then deploying this information throughout the development process. In the process of transformation, the relative weights of customer attributes and the relationship measures between customer attributes and design requirements are fuzzy numbers. The importance of design requirements is calculated by fuzzy weighted average method based on α-cuts, is prioritized by the averaging level cuts to defuzzify in this paper. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the method.

articleTitle: Coordinated development analysis on economic efficiency and technical level of railway transportation industry in China
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Coordinating economic efficiency and technical level is important for sustainable development of railway transportation industry. Based on the coordination theory and principle for composite system, this paper establishes a model describing the coordination degree of economic efficiency and technical level for railway transportation industry. Also, the model is applied to analyze the coordinated development tendency of railway transportation industry in China from 1998 to 2005. The result shows that economic efficiency is still lagging the technological advancement.

articleTitle: Opportunism and alliance risk factors in asymmetric alliances
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Opportunism is the main reason for alliance relational risk and performance risk and even for alliances failure. In the context of asymmetric alliance, the paper analyses the alliance risk factors, suggests that asymmetric information, unbalanced contribution perception, asymmetric learning race, culture confliction, is the four risk factors that can not be ignored for alliances between large and small firms.

articleTitle: Identification of nonstationary time series based on SVM-HMM method
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Nonstationary time series are occurring when the plant proceeds to an abnormal state or a transient situation from a normal state. So it is necessary to identify the type of fault during its early stages for the selection of appropriate operator actions to prevent a more severe situation. This paper proposes a new architecture for identification of the time series. It converts the output of support vector machine (SVM) into the form of posterior probability which is computed by the combined use of sigmoid function and Gauss model, it acts as a probability evaluator in the hidden states of hidden Markov models (HMM). Experiments show that the architecture is very effective.

articleTitle: A genetic algorithm for disassembly scheduling with assembly product structure
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper considers a production planning problem in disassembly systems, which is the problem of determining the quantity and timing of disassembling used or end-of-life products in order to satisfy the demand of their parts or components over a finite planning horizon. We study the case of single product type without parts commonality, that is, assembly product structure. The objective is to minimize the sum of setup, disassembly operation, and inventory holding costs. A genetic algorithm is developed based on several properties of optimal solutions. Results of computational experiments on randomly generated test problems indicate that the genetic algorithm gives the optimal solutions up to all moderate-sized problems in a short amount of computation time (less than 1 minute).

articleTitle: The development model of Web applications based on mashups
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Mashups are an exciting genre of interactive Web applications that draw upon content retrieved from external data sources to create entirely new and innovative services. They are a hallmark of the Web2.0 applications. This article explores what it means to be a mashup, the mashup ecosystem, and the development model of Web application based on mashups in the IT industry.

articleTitle: What and how can we learn from ZARA
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The paper analyzed four key links and concluded three of the advanced ideas by searching on the efficient supply chain of ZARA which is the well-known world-level garment brand. Then the paper releases to the public what is possible for those Chinese costume enterprises which can borrow the successful experience from ZARA and what is impossible to imitate ZARA for aims to propose some constructive suggestions for the development of domestic costume enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on mobile commerce based on RFID
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: With promising progress of wireless network technology and mobile devices, the mobile commerce is becoming a feasible extension of electric commerce. However, Research on mobile commerce based on RFID is still in leading strings. In this paper, we firstly analyzed the current Mobile Commerce situation in China, and introduce how to improve m-commerce utilizing mobile RFID technology; Then we discussed the possible applications of this new technology and designed system architecture of mobile commerce based on RFID, the mobile monitor device and RFID middleware; At last we indicated defects and problems of RFID. By implementing RFID, mobile commerce will further make progress in future.

articleTitle: The process modeling of creating work breakdown structures of automobile R&D project based on PDCA
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Work breakdown structures are the base for project management. The quality of work breakdown structures of automobile R&D project directly affects the control of the process of automobile new product development in time, cost, scope, quality and other aspects. In order to improve the quality of work breakdown structures, the paper introduces Plan-Do-Check-Action cycle and develops a distinct process model by integrating the objective management and process management. The model contains four key indicators, such as scope, awareness, responsibility and risk, to evaluate the quality of work breakdown structures in the process. The paper also presents specific tools and methods to the implementation of the model with example.

articleTitle: Strategic coopertation&development of modern logistic industry in area along NELB
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The development of modern logistic industry in the Area along the New Eurasian Land Bridge (NELB) is significant to promote the socio-economic development of the Chinese mid-west region. Based on the analysis of status achievement and existing problems of logistic cooperation&development (C&D) in the Area, this paper discusses its development trend with forecasting the relationship between economy and logistic development. And according to SWOT analysis, it makes a development strategy with applicability in long views, and designs the whole layout and integrated logistic cooperation pattern. The result could be used for reference to develop the modern logistic industry in the Area.

Author Keywords: Area along New Eurasian Land Bridge

articleTitle: Enterprise planning of Total Life cycle Lean Thinking
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The application of lean thinking obtains saltant advancements and has turned into a new generation guidance thinking of management revolution since 21st century. However, because lean thinking was born of 'production' and 'manufacturing', people mistake 'lean' as JIT etc chronically, and traditional applications of lean thinking are also limited in 'production', 'manufacturing' and JIT. This article points out the limitations of traditional thinking and advances 'total life cycle lean thinking' throughout the total life cycle of product on this basis. Afterwards, the article applies 'lean thinking' to plant design, that is enterprise planning, and then expatiates on enterprise planning.

articleTitle: Staffing a call center with interactive voice response units and impatient calls
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: A call center consists of telephone trunk lines, a switching machine known as the automatic call distributor (ACD), an interactive voice recording unit (IVRU), and telephone sales agents. Calls enter the center whenever a trunk line is available; otherwise it is lost. Once a trunk line is seized, the call is instructed to choose among several options provided by the call center, via the IVRU. After completing the instructions at the IVRU, the call may leave the center or be routed to an available agent. If all agents are busy, the call is queued at the ACD until one is free. While waiting for the agents, calls may abandon the queue if their waiting time becomes unreasonably long. The reason for impatience and abandonment varies from call to call and it is difficult to quantify. In this paper, we assume that each call abandons the queue independently of each other while waiting for agents after a random amount of time.With this assumption, a serial network model is introduced to determine the optimal quantities of the number of trunk lines and agents subject to given service level. It is shown that abandonment of calls will influence the waiting time and hence the number of agents needed to meet a specific service level. With abandonment, this model provides a reasonable way to determine the number of trunk lines and agents required simultaneously. Numerical examples will illustrate the effects of abandonment on design parameters.

articleTitle: Research on public parking lots planning based on traffic demand management
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper introduced the concept of traffic demand management into the process of parking lots planning, and efforts were taken to achieve the traffic demand management concept which advocated go-aheadism, homeostasis and public transport priority. During the parking demand forecast stage, varieties in the transport structure and trip mode arising from the changes in dynamic traffic and demand management policies were taken into account, a model for forecasting parking demand was established whose results are more in line with actual parking needs. During parking lots distribution stage, the initiative influence of the parking lots was studied, and the principles for parking lots distribution were proposed out respectively from a macro strategic point of view, from the micro-strategic point of view and from the middle-level strategic point of view. According the parking service characteristic and the public transport priority rule in traffic demand management, a parking lots distribution optimization model was built under the consideration of dynamic traffic needs. The result can provide the theory foundation for public parking lots planning reasonably.

articleTitle: An enhanced model for TOC Supply Chain Replenishment Systems under capacity constraint
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The TOC Supply Chain Replenishment System (TOC-SCRS) is a replenishment method of the TOC supply chain solution and now being implemented by a growing number of companies. The performance reported by the implemented companies includes reduction of inventory level, lead-time and transportation costs and increasing forecast accuracy and customer service levels. However, when the TOC-SCRS is applied in a plant or a central warehouse, the determination of reliable replenishment time will encounter a conflict with the replenishment quantity, especially under the constraint of limited plant capacity. An enhanced replenishment model for TOC-SCRS under capacity constraint is then developed. A numeric example and a sensitivity analysis are utilized to evaluate the application of the proposed method. Employing this proposed methodology will facilitate a plant or a central warehouse to successfully implement an effective TOC-SCRS.

Author Keywords: TOC Supply Chain Replenishment System component

articleTitle: Distributed resource allocation for healthcare systems
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Healthcare costs in most developed economies have grown dramatically over the last few decades. It is widely believed that the inefficiency of healthcare institutions has contributed to this rise. In response to this belief, much scholarly attention has been devoted to allocating resources for efficient operation of healthcare institutions. Traditionally, centralized methods are applied to such problems. However, the inherent, decentralized nature of many hospitals for the same healthcare corporation drives the investigation on decentralized or distributed methods. This paper explores the application of a linear and a nonlinear pricing model for healthcare resource allocation in specific, staffing configurations. A simulation model for hospital Emergency Room (ER) is developed to collect the performance data. The data is then analyzed to construct Linear Programming (LP) model for each ER staffing configuration problem. Two pricing models are employed to find the equilibrium solutions between two ERs.

articleTitle: Research on the realization and application of WebGIS for high-speed railway
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: With the widespread application of Internet/Intranet, the interoperability and portability are the most important issues in open geographic information system so that a WebGIS based on Internet/Intranet and hybrid strategy dispatch management system is presented, and it has been the chief tendency of the development of GIS (geographical information system). High-speed Railway Fundamental Information Database System (HSRDB) is an important science and technology project of railway ministry in 2006 of China. How to display the information using GIS for high-speed railway is the research aim of this paper. Currently WebGIS is widely used in many fields, however its application in high-speed railway is relatively new. This paper proposes a four-layer structure of the GIS based on WebGIS for high-speed railway, which includes client layer, web server layer, application layer and database layer. On the basis of it, the paper discusses the system's software architecture, achievement method and its functions. Finally, the paper also introduces the key technologies in system achievement.

articleTitle: Study on the models of cross-chain inventory collaboration in the cluster supply chain
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Considering the cross-chain inventory collaboration in the cluster supply chain, this paper discussed and comparatively analyzed two models: the one is cross-chain inventory complementarily between enterprises of same tier and the other one is cross-chain inventory complementarily between enterprises of different tiers with the methods of system dynamics simulation. By the analysis of the simulation data, the paper found that using inventory complementarily between enterprises of different tiers can lead to a higher satisfaction rate of customer demand without big changes of inventory and can maintain this large satisfaction rate stably. Therefore, from the perspective of the inventory and customer satisfaction rate, the complementarily model between enterprises of different tiers is superior to the model between enterprises of same tier.

articleTitle: Modeling emission limits in product planning
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper presents novel methods to model different emission limits in product planning problem. Along with the increasing environmental pollution and increasing environmental charges and taxes, modeling emission limits become critical for manufactures. This paper divides emission limits into three categories: periodical emission limits, overall emission limits and tradable emission limits. Correspondingly, three different mathematical models are presented to integrate emission limits in product planning. Furthermore, Watson Implosion Technology (WIT) toolkit is introduced to optimize the problem, while emission limits are modeled as capacity, material and purchasable material respectively. The tradable model is also extended to consider developing a replaceable product with lower emission, while it tells manufactures when a new green product should be researched. Experiments demonstrate quantitative influences of different kind of emission limits, and the results indicate that our method can help to make the strategic decision and maximize profits with emissions compliance.

articleTitle: Location based services combined with GPS and 3G wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: There are increasing demands of location based services on traffic, travel, emergency, special crowd, and etc. With the development of measurement technique in wireless networks and applications of 3GPP release 4 on TD-SCDMA in China, It plays a more important role in positioning service for the customs using wireless networks technology. New and innovative ways are continuously pursued by mobile network operators to offer service and increase profit. The technology of the fundamental location estimates combined with Global Positioning System ( GPS ) and 3G wireless networks are presented first in the paper. Then a 4-steps method using wide-area continuous positioning combined with 3G system and GPS is developed through its operation process. Finally, the operation process is demonstrated within 3GPP TD-SCDMA combine with GPS.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Research on the method about performance of the whole ecotype supply chain
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: With environment worsening and resource decreasing, enterprises have to bear more and more pressures on the environmental protection. How to reduce the due responsibility of enterprises for environmental protection in the life cycle of products has became the focus problem of the decision-makers. The strategy of ecotype supply chain can solve this problem effectively. In this paper, the authors first briefly explain the concept and characteristics of the ecotype supply chain, and then focus on discussing the performance measurement of ecotype supply chain and further improvement of performance evaluation index system of the traditional supply chain. Based on the above discussion, the authors establish evaluation model and method of the whole ecotype supply chain performance, which offers effective decision-making approach for the sustainable development of the enterprises in the future market competition.

articleTitle: Grey analytic hierarchy process applied to aeroengine health assessment
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Aeroengine is a complex system, which is controlled by a number of interrelated factors and is difficult to estimate. To overcome the obstacles of conventional health assessment of aeroengine, this paper proposed an effectiveness evaluation method for aeroengine health assessment which combined the advantages of the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and a grey clustering method to guarantee the accuracy and objectivity of weight coefficients. After constructing an index system of aeroengine health assessment based on correlated factors involved in aeroengine health status, we confirmed the weight of every index with AHP and gave a general health assessment by means of a grey clustering method. A case study was conducted to validate the design of the underlying grey analytic hierarchy process (GAHP) model. Running results show the feasibility and reliability of the model, which will be helpful to realize the quantitative analysis in aeroengine health assessment and provide a decision support tool for decision makers.

articleTitle: Analysis on the legal issues of e-commerce contract
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The electronic contract is greatly different with traditional contract, which triggers a lot of new legal issues. Based on Chinese legislative practice, this article analyzes the main issues in electronic contracts, including: the client capacity, the offer and acceptance in the electronic contract formation process, the establishment time and place of electronic contracts, the electronic signatures, the evidential weight of electronic contracts, and the conflicts of jurisdiction. In the end, the author come to a conclusion that China must establish a set of electronic contract rules linked to the international practices to adapt to e-commerce development.

articleTitle: Efficient order picking based on community detection
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Order picking is the most labour-intensive and costly activity for almost every warehouse. In general, travel time of pickers during the order picking process is the dominant component of the total order picking time. This paper proposes an approach to decrease travel time by sharply cut down the step time in each picking operation. The reduction of step time is fulfilled by putting the goods nearby, which appear in a single order with higher probability. Social network and community detection are introduced into the discovering of the items which may be picked together in one picking operation. This method can bring higher efficiency and lower operation cost for distribution centers, and consequently for the whole supply chain.
