articleTitle: The analyses on the oligarch game in the competition of the regional hub port
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: The Stackelberg model is often used to study on the suck cost and the barriers to entry between the enterprises competition. The paper analyzes the situation of two port enterprises competition in the intra-regional by means of the Stackelberg model and the HSS. It studies on two port enterprises competition under the hypothesis of no fixed entry cost and with the fixed entry cost based on the features of them. The former reflects the first-mover advantage of the leading port; the later analyzes the monopoly condition of the leading port. Combined with the hub-and-spoke system (HSS), it also analyzes the first-mover advantage of the leading port enterprise. The paper studies on the competition of the regional hub port between Dalian port and Yingkou port in the Northeast of China. It can be got that Dalian port has the first-mover advantage significantly, and with the strengthening in the separation of enterprise from government, this advantage will make Dalian port take the monopoly position in the future.

articleTitle: Approximation algorithm for A bicriteria multicommodity flow problem
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: In the present work, one of bicriteria multicommodity flow problem, called as Maximum Flow Problem with Minimized Maximum of Met Rates, is proposed to find a certain kind of weak solutions for the operational decisions of many practical situations with multicommodity flow, for instance, the emergency logistics distribution decision stemming from the action of China's reliving the areas suffering the tremendous snow disaster in the beginning of 2008. For the problem, the existence of solutions is proved, a pseudopolynomial time approximation algorithm to solve it is designed, finally an approximation measure on the algorithm we design is proposed and proved.

articleTitle: Measuring cost efficiency in the hotel sector: A case from China's Zhejiang province
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: This paper investigates the hotel cost efficiency in Zhejiang province by using the method of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA). DEA is estimated with three inputs (i.e. labor, capital and materials) and three outputs (i.e. room revenue, F&B revenue and other revenues). The sample used consists of 179 hotels in Zhejiang province ranging from two-star to five-star hotels. The results reveal each hotel's technical efficiency, allocative efficiency and cost efficiency. ANOVA is utilized to detect if there exists efficiency difference between different types of hotels. It shows that hotel grade and scale appear to significantly affect hotel efficiency. However, no evidence can be found that efficiency is affected by ownership and operation type. Managerial implications are discussed at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Improving Health Care access by optimizing the allocation network of community health centers
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: As the community health care plays an important role in improving the health care equality and efficiency nowadays, It is one of the targets of the health care reform to establish a well distributed geographical community health network in China. In this paper, taking Haidian District in Beijing City as an example, the CHCs locations as well as the service allocation problem is solved by using an integer linear mathematical programming model. The results show that the optimization of the CHCs network could improve the community health care access while reducing the cost per encounter under the government's budget, which makes the health care resource allocation more efficient. The decision making of government policy makers could also be well supported by the model.

articleTitle: Study on the IT synergies capability and its Order Parameter Model in complex structure orgnizations
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Information technologies have a wide range of applicability across almost all industries. The fundamental principles of good IT management are also applicable in many industries. Thus, firms whose business units operate in different industries have an opportunity to exploit cross-unit IT synergies by applying their IT resources and capabilities across multiple units. This study examines sources of cross-unit IT synergy and constructs the Order Parameter Model of the IT synergy capability. Building on the resource-based view of diversification and the economic theory of complementarities, the study identifies the relatedness and complementarity of IT resources as two major sources of cross-unit IT synergy. It argues that IT relatedness creates sub-additive cost synergies, whereas complementarities among IT infrastructure technologies and IT management processes create super-additive value synergies. Building on the Synergetic Theory, the study also examines the mechanism of IT Synergy and constructs the Order Parameter Model. At the end of this paper, we have a conclusion and future work expectation of IT Synergic in CSOs.

articleTitle: A new methodology for designing collaborative information system in a virtual team: A case study
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Recently, more and more people have awareness that we should focus on the communication, cooperation and coordination (3Cs) among the actors in virtual teams. Much researches on designing methodologies for collaborative information system in academic and industrial communities in many countries. This paper introduces a new methodology called awareness net model for considering how to design collaborative information system in the virtual team. This whole processes through constructs the net graph (awareness net) to describe the relationships among the actors within virtual teams, and analyze actor's collaborative requirement of awareness by five awareness levels (level-0 to level-4 awareness). Could the awareness net model be used in Chinese company? A case study representing a collaborative process in customer service department in Gome Corporation is used throughout this paper. Finally, the author find out the application of the methodology contribute to identifying the collaborative requirement of actors and designing what kind of databases, interactive interface, communication tools, et are needed in Gome Corporation.

articleTitle: Development research on SOA-based Postgraduate Education Administration Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Nowadays, "Information Islands", inadequate flexibility and reusability are primary problems existing in postgraduate education administration systems (PEAS). To solve those problems, in this paper, Service Oriented Architecture is introduced into Rational Unified Process (RUP) for developing integrated PEAS with much improved flexibility and reusability. Models devised in three core workflows of RUP: business modeling, requirements, analysis and design, are presented in sequence and the feasibility of those models is validated by a prototype implemented by using web services.

articleTitle: Operational framework and decision flow analyses on supply chain resources integration in 4PL
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: At present, the successful operations of 4PL in practice have gradually demonstrated that it is an effective mode to integrate the complex resources efficiently and flexibly in the supply chain. But there are not an effective theory and a quantitative method to guide the enterprises. To solve this bottleneck in the operational expansion of 4PL in practice and to set up a systemic 4PL integration framework to make decision, in this paper, based on the more detailed literature review, the dominant factors which are most important in the decision process of the supply chain resources integration in 4PL are analyzed at operational level from the perspective of value increment theory and systemic integration principles. Then, based on these dominant factors, a series of relations about 4PL integration are discussed, the 4PL integration operational framework and the integration decision optimization flow for this complex integration are analyzed and then an integration decision optimization flow chart are built to guide the practice. The content discussed in this paper is important basis for in-depth quantitative research of the supply chain resources integration in 4PL.

articleTitle: Research on supply chain coordination mechanism based on fuzzy sale price
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: In a two-level supply chain composed of one supplier and one retailer, the sale price fluctuation may result in the problem of coordination in supply chain. The basic point and fluctuating scopes of sale price, the fuzzy profits estimated values were analyzed under the Stackelberg equilibrium and the cooperative game equilibrium. The comparison of the values of the parameters was given at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: An improved authentication and key agreement protocol preserving user's privacy using smart cards
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics
abstract: Recently, a privacy enhanced authentication and key agreement protocol was proposed using elliptic curve cryptograph technology. The scheme is insecure, however, against replay attacks within valid period of certificate and loses users' privacy that should be protected. In this paper we propose an improved authentication and key agreement protocol by employing smart card and random number technology. Replay attacks are thus blocked without the need of time synchronization between computers. Moreover, we develop a secure mechanism to protect users' identity privacy and a convenient password change method without the participation of the server. Our protocol is more secure compared with others at similar computation cost in the authentication period.
